CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.crm_attribute_oil_campaign_conversion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_order_status text;
  v_order_customer_id uuid;
  v_order_vehicle_id uuid;
  v_location_code text;
  v_order_business_at timestamptz;
begin
  if new.order_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  select
    o.status,
    o.customer_id,
    o.vehicle_id,
    l.code,
    coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at)
  into
    v_order_status,
    v_order_customer_id,
    v_order_vehicle_id,
    v_location_code,
    v_order_business_at
  from public.orders o
  left join public.locations l on l.id = o.location_id
  where o.id = new.order_id;

  if not found
     or v_order_status <> 'CLOSED'
     or v_location_code <> 'CABUDARE' then
    return new;
  end if;

  update public.crm_campaign_contacts cc
  set status = 'CONVERTED',
      visited_at = coalesce(cc.visited_at, new.performed_at),
      converted_at = coalesce(cc.converted_at, new.performed_at),
      converted_order_id = coalesce(cc.converted_order_id, new.order_id),
      outcome_note = coalesce(
        cc.outcome_note,
        'Conversión detectada automáticamente por regreso del vehículo a Lubricenter Cabudare.'
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  from public.crm_campaigns c
  where c.id = cc.campaign_id
    and c.slug = 'aceite-inyectores-oct-2026'
    and cc.sent_at is not null
    and v_order_business_at >= cc.sent_at
    and new.performed_at >= cc.sent_at
    and (
      c.ends_on is null
      or (
        v_order_business_at < ((c.ends_on + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
        and new.performed_at < ((c.ends_on + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      )
    )
    and (
      (cc.vehicle_id is not null and cc.vehicle_id = coalesce(new.vehicle_id, v_order_vehicle_id))
      or
      (cc.vehicle_id is null and cc.customer_id = coalesce(new.customer_id, v_order_customer_id))
    )
    and cc.status <> 'CONVERTED';

  return new;
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_bdv_window_covered(p_account_id uuid, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with bounds as (
  select timezone('America/Caracas',p_occurred_at-interval '48 hours')::date first_day,
         timezone('America/Caracas',p_occurred_at+interval '48 hours')::date last_day
 ), verified as (
  select b.id,b.requested_from,b.requested_to,b.controls
  from public.external_import_batches b join public.external_sources s on s.id=b.source_id
  cross join bounds z
  where s.provider='BDV' and s.account_id=p_account_id and b.status='COMPLETE'
   and b.requested_from<=z.last_day and b.requested_to>=z.first_day
 )
 select (select last_day from bounds)<timezone('America/Caracas',now())::date and not exists (
  select 1 from bounds z,
   generate_series(z.first_day,z.last_day,interval '1 day') d
  where not exists(select 1 from verified b where d::date between b.requested_from and b.requested_to)
 ) and not exists (
  select 1 from verified a join verified b on b.requested_from=a.requested_to+1
  where (a.controls->>'closing')::numeric is distinct from (b.controls->>'opening')::numeric
 )
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_case(p_key text, p_kind text, p_type text, p_id uuid, p_title text, p_explanation text, p_evidence jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_id uuid;
begin
 insert into public.reconciliation_cases(case_key,kind,subject_type,subject_id,title,explanation,evidence,updated_at)
 values(p_key,p_kind,p_type,p_id,p_title,p_explanation,p_evidence,clock_timestamp())
 on conflict(case_key) do update set title=excluded.title,explanation=excluded.explanation,evidence=excluded.evidence,
 status=case when public.reconciliation_cases.status='DISMISSED' and public.reconciliation_cases.evidence=excluded.evidence then 'DISMISSED' else 'OPEN' end,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 returning id into v_id; return v_id;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_cash_movement_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare a uuid; d date; v_close uuid;
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(220033);
 for a,d in
  select case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.account_id else new.account_id end,
   timezone('America/Caracas',case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.occurred_at else new.occurred_at end)::date
  union
  select case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.account_id else old.account_id end,
   timezone('America/Caracas',case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.occurred_at else old.occurred_at end)::date
 loop
  if exists(select 1 from public.financial_accounts
   where id=a and account_type='CASH') then
   select c.id into v_close
   from public.cash_closings c
   join public.cash_closing_accounts ca on ca.cash_closing_id=c.id
   where ca.account_id=a and ca.actual_native is not null
    and c.finance_version=22 and c.status in ('CLOSED','REVIEW')
    and c.business_date>=d
   order by c.business_date,c.id limit 1;
   update public.cash_closings set status='REVIEW',
    review_reason='Se registró o corrigió un movimiento de efectivo anterior al conteo',
    updated_at=now()
   where id=v_close and status='CLOSED';
  end if;
 end loop;
 return coalesce(new,old);
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_cash_totals(p_day date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, currency text, account_type text, activated boolean, opening_native numeric, system_in_native numeric, system_out_native numeric, expected_native numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with bases as (
  select a.*,o.account_id is not null and timezone('America/Caracas',o.effective_at)::date<=p_day activated,
   coalesce(prev.actual_native,o.amount,0) base,
   coalesce(((prev.business_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas'),o.effective_at) since
  from public.financial_accounts a left join public.finance_cash_openings o on o.account_id=a.id
  left join lateral(select d.actual_native,c.business_date from public.cash_closing_accounts d join public.cash_closings c on c.id=d.cash_closing_id
   where d.account_id=a.id and c.finance_version=22 and c.status in ('CLOSED','REVIEW') and c.business_date<p_day and d.actual_native is not null
   and c.business_date>=timezone('America/Caracas',o.effective_at)::date order by c.business_date desc limit 1) prev on true
  where a.active and a.code in ('CASH_USD','CASH_VES') and a.account_type='CASH'
 ), sums as (
  select b.id,b.code,b.name,b.currency,b.account_type,b.activated,
   b.base+coalesce(sum(case when m.direction='IN' then m.amount_original else -m.amount_original end) filter(where m.occurred_at<(p_day::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')),0) opening_native,
   coalesce(sum(m.amount_original) filter(where m.direction='IN' and m.occurred_at>=(p_day::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')),0) system_in_native,
   coalesce(sum(m.amount_original) filter(where m.direction='OUT' and m.occurred_at>=(p_day::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')),0) system_out_native
  from bases b left join public.account_movements m on m.account_id=b.id and m.occurred_at>=b.since and m.occurred_at<((p_day+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  group by b.id,b.code,b.name,b.currency,b.account_type,b.activated,b.base
 ) select *,opening_native+system_in_native-system_out_native expected_native from sums
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_currency_summary(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_from timestamptz;
  v_until timestamptz;
  v_data jsonb;
begin
  perform lubricenter_private.finance_require();
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from > p_to or p_to-p_from > 366 then
    raise exception 'Selecciona un período válido de máximo 367 días';
  end if;
  v_from := p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';
  v_until := (p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';

  with movements as (
    select m.id, m.account_id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type, a.currency,
      m.direction, m.movement_type, m.finance_nature, m.transfer_group,
      m.amount_original, m.occurred_at,
      coalesce(nullif(p.bcv_rate_snapshot,0), rb.value) bcv,
      coalesce(nullif(p.operative_rate_snapshot,0), ro.value) operative
    from public.account_movements m
    join public.financial_accounts a on a.id=m.account_id
    left join public.payments p on p.id=m.source_payment_id
    left join lateral (
      select r.value from public.exchange_rates r
      where r.rate_type='BCV' and r.effective_at <= m.occurred_at
      order by r.effective_at desc, r.created_at desc limit 1
    ) rb on true
    left join lateral (
      select r.value from public.exchange_rates r
      where r.rate_type='OPERATIVE' and r.effective_at <= m.occurred_at
      order by r.effective_at desc, r.created_at desc limit 1
    ) ro on true
    where m.occurred_at >= v_from and m.occurred_at < v_until
      and a.account_type <> 'RELATED'
  ), totals as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN'),0) ves_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT'),0) ves_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) ves_external_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) ves_external_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN' and movement_type='PAYMENT'),0) ves_payments,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='USD' and direction='IN'),0) usd_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='USD' and direction='OUT'),0) usd_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='USD' and direction='IN' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) usd_external_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='USD' and direction='OUT' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) usd_external_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original) filter(where currency='USD' and direction='IN' and movement_type='PAYMENT'),0) usd_payments,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(bcv,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN'),0) bcv_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(bcv,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT'),0) bcv_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(bcv,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) bcv_external_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(bcv,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) bcv_external_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(bcv,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN' and movement_type='PAYMENT'),0) bcv_payments,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(operative,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN'),0) op_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(operative,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT'),0) op_out,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(operative,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='IN' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) op_external_in,
      coalesce(sum(amount_original / nullif(operative,0)) filter(where currency='VES' and direction='OUT' and movement_type<>'TRANSFER'),0) op_external_out,
      count(*) filter(where currency='VES' and (bcv is null or bcv<=0)) missing_bcv,
      count(*) filter(where currency='VES' and (operative is null or operative<=0)) missing_op,
      count(*) filter(where movement_type='ADJUSTMENT' and finance_nature is null) unclassified_adjustments,
      count(*) filter(where movement_type='TRANSFER' and transfer_group is null) unmatched_transfers
    from movements
  ), sales as (
    -- Allocation by recorded payment currency, dated by the CLOSED order's business date.
    -- Unpaid/financed portions remain unallocated, never silently mapped to VES or USD.
    select
      coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='VES'),0) ves_assigned,
      coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) usd_assigned,
      count(distinct o.id) orders_with_payments
    from public.orders o join public.payments p on p.order_id=o.id
    where o.status='CLOSED'
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)>=v_from
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)<v_until
  ), cashea as (
    select count(*) sales,
      coalesce(sum(cs.gross_ref),0) gross_ref,
      coalesce(sum(cs.initial_ref),0) initial_ref,
      coalesce(sum(cs.financed_ref),0) financed_ref,
      coalesce(sum(cs.commission_ref),0) commission_ref
    from public.cashea_sales cs
    join public.orders o on o.id=cs.order_id
    where cs.ownership_status='OWN' and o.status='CLOSED'
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)>=v_from
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)<v_until
  ), cashea_payouts as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(e.amount_ref) filter(where x.ownership_status='OWN'),0) linked_ref,
      count(*) filter(where e.bank_transaction_id is null) unlinked
    from public.cashea_balance_events e
    left join public.external_transactions x on x.id=e.bank_transaction_id
    where e.kind='PAYOUT' and e.reversed_at is null
      and e.occurred_on between p_from and p_to
  ), per_account as (
    select a.id, a.code, a.name, a.currency, a.account_type,
      coalesce((select sum(case when m.direction='IN' then m.amount_original else -m.amount_original end)
        from public.account_movements m where m.account_id=a.id and m.occurred_at<v_from),0) opening,
      coalesce((select sum(m.amount_original)
        from public.account_movements m where m.account_id=a.id and m.direction='IN' and m.occurred_at>=v_from and m.occurred_at<v_until),0) incoming,
      coalesce((select sum(m.amount_original)
        from public.account_movements m where m.account_id=a.id and m.direction='OUT' and m.occurred_at>=v_from and m.occurred_at<v_until),0) outgoing,
      coalesce((select sum(case when m.direction='IN' then m.amount_original else -m.amount_original end)
        from public.account_movements m where m.account_id=a.id and m.occurred_at<v_until),0) closing,
      (select ca.actual_native from public.cash_closing_accounts ca
        join public.cash_closings cc on cc.id=ca.cash_closing_id
        where ca.account_id=a.id and cc.business_date=p_to
          and cc.status in ('REVIEW','CLOSED')
        order by cc.updated_at desc limit 1) counted
    from public.financial_accounts a
    where a.active and a.account_type<>'RELATED'
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'period',jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to),
    'bs',jsonb_build_object('sales_assigned',s.ves_assigned,'collections',t.ves_payments,
      'entries',t.ves_in,'external_entries',t.ves_external_in,
      'outflows',t.ves_out,'external_outflows',t.ves_external_out),
    'bcv',jsonb_build_object('collections',case when t.missing_bcv>0 then null else t.bcv_payments end,
      'entries',case when t.missing_bcv>0 then null else t.bcv_in end,
      'external_entries',case when t.missing_bcv>0 then null else t.bcv_external_in end,
      'outflows',case when t.missing_bcv>0 then null else t.bcv_out end,
      'external_outflows',case when t.missing_bcv>0 then null else t.bcv_external_out end),
    'usd',jsonb_build_object('sales_assigned',s.usd_assigned,'collections',t.usd_payments,
      'entries',t.usd_in,'external_entries',t.usd_external_in,
      'outflows',t.usd_out,'external_outflows',t.usd_external_out),
    'operative',jsonb_build_object('entries',case when t.missing_op>0 then null else t.op_in end,
      'external_entries',case when t.missing_op>0 then null else t.op_external_in end,
      'outflows',case when t.missing_op>0 then null else t.op_out end,
      'external_outflows',case when t.missing_op>0 then null else t.op_external_out end),
    'accounts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.currency,a.name) from per_account a),'[]'::jsonb),
    'cashea',jsonb_build_object('sales',c.sales,'gross_ref',c.gross_ref,'initial_ref',c.initial_ref,
      'financed_ref',c.financed_ref,'commission_ref',c.commission_ref,
      'payouts_linked_ref',cp.linked_ref,'payouts_unlinked',cp.unlinked),
    'warnings',jsonb_build_object('bcv_missing',t.missing_bcv,'operative_missing',t.missing_op,
      'unclassified_adjustments',t.unclassified_adjustments,
      'unmatched_transfers',t.unmatched_transfers)
  ) into v_data
  from totals t cross join sales s cross join cashea c cross join cashea_payouts cp;
  return v_data;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_exact_bank_mismatches(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(payment_id uuid, order_id uuid, order_number text, external_transaction_id uuid, recorded_account text, actual_account text, reference text, recorded_ves numeric, verified_ves numeric, paid_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id payment_id,p.order_id,o.order_number,et.id external_transaction_id,
    original_account.code recorded_account,ext_account.code actual_account,
    p.reference,p.amount_original recorded_ves,et.amount verified_ves,p.paid_at,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id) payment_candidates,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY et.id) external_candidates
  FROM public.payments p
  JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=p.order_id AND o.status='CLOSED'
  JOIN public.financial_accounts original_account ON original_account.id=p.financial_account_id
    AND original_account.code IN ('BDV','BNC')
  JOIN public.external_transactions et ON et.direction='IN' AND et.currency='VES'
    AND abs(et.amount-p.amount_original)<=0.01
    AND et.occurred_at BETWEEN p.paid_at-interval '2 days' AND p.paid_at+interval '2 days'
  JOIN public.external_sources es ON es.id=et.source_id
  JOIN public.financial_accounts ext_account ON ext_account.id=es.account_id
    AND ext_account.code IN ('BDV','BNC')
  WHERE p.method IN ('TRANSFER_BDV','TRANSFER_BNC')
    AND p.reference ~ '^\d{4,32}$'
    AND right(regexp_replace(coalesce(et.reference,''),'[^0-9]','','g'),length(p.reference))=p.reference
    AND (p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.reconciliation_allocations a
      JOIN public.account_movements m ON m.id=a.account_movement_id
      WHERE m.source_payment_id=p.id AND a.reversed_at IS NULL)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_tenders t WHERE t.payment_id=p.id)
 )
 SELECT c.payment_id,c.order_id,c.order_number,c.external_transaction_id,
   c.recorded_account,c.actual_account,c.reference,c.recorded_ves,c.verified_ves,c.paid_at
 FROM candidates c WHERE c.payment_candidates=1 AND c.external_candidates=1
   AND c.recorded_account<>c.actual_account;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_export_period(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_rows jsonb;v_orders jsonb;v_sources jsonb;v_total integer;v_pending integer;v_period_status text;v_is_final boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.finance_require();
 IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<p_from OR p_to-p_from>92 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selecciona un período válido de máximo 93 días';
 END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO v_total FROM public.external_transactions x
 WHERE timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to;
 IF v_total>10000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Demasiados movimientos para un reporte. Divide el período';END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.occurred_at,t.provider,t.reference),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_rows FROM (
 SELECT x.id, s.provider,s.name source_name,timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at) occurred_at,
   x.reference,x.description,x.direction,x.currency,x.amount,x.balance,x.external_order,
   x.installments,x.amount_ref,x.assigned_ref,x.ownership_status,x.nature,x.category,x.classification_reason,
   coalesce(os.order_number,op.order_number,'') order_number,
   coalesce(v.count_alloc,0)::integer allocations,
   coalesce(v.amount_alloc,0)::numeric amount_alloc,
   CASE
    WHEN s.provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' AND x.ownership_status<>'OWN' THEN 'NO_ATRIBUIDO_A_OS'
    WHEN coalesce(v.count_alloc,0)=0 THEN 'PENDIENTE'
    WHEN coalesce(v.amount_alloc,0)+0.000001 <
     CASE WHEN s.provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' THEN coalesce(x.assigned_ref,x.amount_ref,x.amount) ELSE x.amount END
     THEN 'PARCIAL'
    WHEN coalesce(b.verified,false) THEN 'CONCILIADO'
    ELSE 'ASIGNADO_PENDIENTE_VERIFICAR_REPORTE'
   END reconciliation_status,
   coalesce(b.verified,false) report_verified,
   coalesce(v.reason,'') reconciliation_reason
 FROM public.external_transactions x
 JOIN public.external_sources s ON s.id=x.source_id
 LEFT JOIN public.cashea_sales cs ON s.provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' AND cs.cashea_reference=x.external_order
 LEFT JOIN public.orders os ON os.id=cs.order_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) count_alloc,sum(a.external_amount) amount_alloc,string_agg(coalesce(a.reason,a.method),'; ' ORDER BY a.created_at) reason,
         (array_agg(a.account_movement_id ORDER BY a.created_at))[1] account_movement_id
  FROM public.reconciliation_allocations a WHERE a.external_transaction_id=x.id AND a.reversed_at IS NULL
 ) v ON true
 LEFT JOIN public.account_movements am ON am.id=v.account_movement_id
 LEFT JOIN public.payments pay ON pay.id=am.source_payment_id
 LEFT JOIN public.orders op ON op.id=pay.order_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT bool_or(y.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND y.status='COMPLETE') verified
  FROM public.external_batch_transactions link JOIN public.external_import_batches y ON y.id=link.batch_id
  WHERE link.transaction_id=x.id
 ) b ON true
 WHERE timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
 ) t;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(y) ORDER BY y.purchased_on,y.external_order),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_orders FROM (
 SELECT snap.external_order,snap.purchased_on,snap.status,snap.total_ref,snap.initial_ref,
    snap.installments,snap.raw->>'# Factura' invoice_no,
    coalesce(o.order_number,'') order_number,
    CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN 'SIN_FACTURA_OS' ELSE 'RELACIONADA_OS' END relation_status,
    b.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND b.status='COMPLETE' report_verified
 FROM public.cashea_order_snapshots snap
 JOIN public.external_import_batches b ON b.id=snap.batch_id
 LEFT JOIN public.cashea_sales cs ON cs.cashea_reference=snap.external_order
 LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=cs.order_id
 WHERE snap.purchased_on BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
 ) y;
 SELECT count(*) INTO v_pending FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) z
 WHERE z->>'reconciliation_status' NOT IN ('CONCILIADO','NO_ATRIBUIDO_A_OS');

 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('provider',p.provider,
  'records',CASE WHEN p.provider='CASHEA_ORDERS' THEN jsonb_array_length(v_orders) ELSE coalesce(t.n,0) END,
  'in_ves',coalesce(t.in_ves,0),'out_ves',coalesce(t.out_ves,0),
  'own_in_ves',coalesce(t.own_in_ves,0),'unattributed_in_ves',coalesce(t.unattributed_in_ves,0),
  'not_final',coalesce(t.pending,0),
  'coverage',CASE WHEN coalesce(t.n,0)=0 AND p.provider<>'CASHEA_ORDERS' THEN 'SIN_EXTRACTO'
   WHEN p.provider='CASHEA_ORDERS' AND jsonb_array_length(v_orders)=0 THEN 'SIN_EXTRACTO'
   WHEN p.provider='CASHEA_ORDERS' THEN 'REVISAR_ORDENES'
   WHEN coalesce(t.pending,0)>0 THEN 'CONCILIACION_PENDIENTE'
   ELSE 'CONCILIADO_EN_REGISTROS' END)) INTO v_sources
 FROM (VALUES('BDV'),('BNC'),('CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS'),('CASHEA_ORDERS')) p(provider)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) n,
   coalesce(sum((j->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER(WHERE j->>'direction'='IN' AND j->>'currency'='VES'),0) in_ves,
   coalesce(sum((j->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER(WHERE j->>'direction'='OUT' AND j->>'currency'='VES'),0) out_ves,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE j->>'reconciliation_status' NOT IN ('CONCILIADO','NO_ATRIBUIDO_A_OS')) pending,
   coalesce(sum((j->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER(WHERE j->>'direction'='IN' AND j->>'currency'='VES' AND j->>'ownership_status'='OWN'),0) own_in_ves,
   coalesce(sum((j->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER(WHERE j->>'direction'='IN' AND j->>'currency'='VES' AND j->>'ownership_status'<>'OWN'),0) unattributed_in_ves
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) j WHERE j->>'provider'=p.provider
 ) t ON true;
 SELECT rp.status INTO v_period_status FROM public.finance_reconciliation_periods rp
 WHERE rp.period_start<=p_from AND rp.period_end>=p_to
 ORDER BY rp.period_start DESC LIMIT 1;
 v_is_final:=coalesce(v_period_status='CLOSED',false)
  AND v_pending=0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_sources) z WHERE z->>'coverage'='SIN_EXTRACTO')=0
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.external_import_batches b JOIN public.external_sources s ON s.id=b.source_id
     WHERE b.observed_from<=p_to AND b.observed_to>=p_from AND s.provider IN ('BDV','BNC','CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS','CASHEA_ORDERS')
       AND (b.status<>'COMPLETE' OR b.verified_at IS NULL));
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'generated_at',now(),
  'status',CASE WHEN v_is_final THEN 'CONCILIADO' WHEN v_period_status='CLOSED_WITH_EXCEPTION' THEN 'CIERRE_CON_EXCEPCIONES' ELSE 'BORRADOR_HASTA_VERIFICAR_COBERTURA_SALDOS_Y_PENDIENTES' END,
  'transactions',v_rows,'orders',v_orders,'sources',v_sources,'pending_transactions',v_pending,
  'pending_note','Las cuotas Cashea y los abonos BNC son evidencias de fuentes distintas: no sumar ambos como dos ingresos. Los reportes sin cobertura verificada no son conciliación final.');
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_inbox(p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.finance_require();
 return jsonb_build_object('role',lubricenter_private.finance_role(),'total',(select count(*) from public.reconciliation_cases where status='OPEN'),
 'cases',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from (select * from public.reconciliation_cases where status='OPEN' order by created_at,id limit 50 offset greatest(p_offset,0)) c),'[]'),
 'sources',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from public.external_sources s where active),'[]'),
 'users',case when lubricenter_private.finance_role()='OWNER' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'email',u.email,'role',coalesce(m.role,'OPERATOR'))) from auth.users u left join public.finance_memberships m on m.user_id=u.id where u.email_confirmed_at is not null),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end,
 'rules',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from public.reconciliation_rules r where active),'[]'),
 'batches',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)-'payload') from (select * from public.external_import_batches order by created_at desc limit 20) b),'[]'),
 'accounts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'code',code,'currency',currency)) from public.financial_accounts where active),'[]'));
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_management_report(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_start timestamptz; v_end timestamptz; v_result jsonb;
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.finance_require();
 if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>366
    or p_to>(now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date then
  raise exception 'Selecciona fechas válidas, hasta hoy y de máximo 367 días';
 end if;
 v_start:=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';
 v_end:=(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';
 with line_rates as (
  select i.order_id,
   case when sum(i.charged_ves_amount)>0
     and count(*) filter(where i.bcv_rate_snapshot is null or i.bcv_rate_snapshot<=0)=0
    then sum(i.charged_ves_amount/nullif(i.bcv_rate_snapshot,0))/sum(i.charged_ves_amount)
    else null end factor
  from public.order_items i group by i.order_id
 ), checkout as (
  select p.order_id,
   coalesce(sum(p.value_ves) filter(where p.currency='VES'),0) cash_ves,
   coalesce(sum(p.value_ves) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) usd_ves,
   coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) usd_native,
   array_agg(distinct p.method order by p.method) methods
  from public.payments p
  where p.receivable_id is null and p.paid_at<v_end
  group by p.order_id
 ), invoices as (
  select o.id,o.order_number,coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at) business_at,
   coalesce(c.name,'Cliente de mostrador') customer,coalesce(v.plate,'') plate,
   coalesce(l.name,'Sede sin identificar') location,
   o.total_ves,lr.factor,cs.id is not null is_cashea,
   cs.id is not null and (cs.ownership_status is distinct from 'OWN' or cs.status='CANCELLED') excluded,
   coalesce(ch.cash_ves,0) cash_ves,coalesce(ch.usd_ves,0) usd_ves,
   coalesce(ch.usd_native,0) usd_native,coalesce(ch.methods,'{}'::text[]) methods,
   coalesce(cs.initial_ref,0) initial_ref,coalesce(cs.financed_ref,0) financed_ref,
   coalesce(cs.commission_ref,0) commission_ref
  from public.orders o
  left join line_rates lr on lr.order_id=o.id
  left join checkout ch on ch.order_id=o.id
  left join public.cashea_sales cs on cs.order_id=o.id
  left join public.customers c on c.id=o.customer_id
  left join public.vehicles v on v.id=o.vehicle_id
  left join public.locations l on l.id=o.location_id
  where o.status='CLOSED' and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)>=v_start
   and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)<v_end
 ), allocation as (
  select *,case when is_cashea then total_ves else 0 end cashea_ves,
   case when is_cashea then 0 else cash_ves end contado_ves,
   case when is_cashea then 0 else usd_native end divisas_usd,
   case when is_cashea then 0 else greatest(total_ves-cash_ves-usd_ves,0) end credit_ves,
   (cash_ves+usd_ves>total_ves+0.01) overpaid
  from invoices where not excluded
 ), allocated as (
  select *,case when cashea_ves=0 then 0 else cashea_ves*factor end cashea_bcv,
   case when contado_ves=0 then 0 else contado_ves*factor end contado_bcv,
   case when credit_ves=0 then 0 else credit_ves*factor end credit_bcv,
   case when is_cashea then 'CASHEA'
    when (case when cash_ves>0 then 1 else 0 end+case when usd_native>0 then 1 else 0 end
      +case when credit_ves>0.01 then 1 else 0 end)>1 then 'MIXTA'
    when credit_ves>0.01 then 'CREDITO' when usd_native>0 then 'DIVISAS' else 'CONTADO' end channel
  from allocation
 ), sales as (
  select count(*) orders,coalesce(sum(total_ves),0) gross_ves,
   coalesce(sum(cashea_ves),0) cashea_ves,coalesce(sum(cashea_bcv),0) cashea_bcv,
   coalesce(sum(contado_ves),0) contado_ves,coalesce(sum(contado_bcv),0) contado_bcv,
   coalesce(sum(divisas_usd),0) divisas_usd,
   coalesce(sum(credit_ves),0) credit_ves,coalesce(sum(credit_bcv),0) credit_bcv,
   count(*) filter(where is_cashea) cashea_orders,
   count(*) filter(where contado_ves>0) contado_orders,
   count(*) filter(where divisas_usd>0) divisas_orders,
   count(*) filter(where credit_ves>0.01) credit_orders,
   count(*) filter(where factor is null and (cashea_ves+contado_ves+credit_ves)>0) missing_rates,
   count(*) filter(where overpaid) overpaid,
   coalesce(sum(initial_ref) filter(where is_cashea),0) cashea_initial_ref,
   coalesce(sum(financed_ref) filter(where is_cashea),0) cashea_financed_ref,
   coalesce(sum(commission_ref) filter(where is_cashea),0) cashea_commission_ref
  from allocated
 ), credit_payments as (
  select receivable_id,sum(value_ves) paid_ves from public.payments
  where receivable_id is not null and paid_at<v_end group by receivable_id
 ), customer_debts as (
  select r.id,r.order_id,o.order_number,coalesce(c.name,'Cliente sin identificar') customer,
   r.due_date,r.principal_ves,greatest(r.principal_ves-coalesce(cp.paid_ves,0),0) outstanding_ves,
   lr.factor
  from public.receivables r
  join public.orders o on o.id=r.order_id and o.status='CLOSED'
  left join public.customers c on c.id=r.customer_id
  left join line_rates lr on lr.order_id=r.order_id
  left join credit_payments cp on cp.receivable_id=r.id
  where r.debtor_type<>'CASHEA' and r.created_at<v_end
   and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)<v_end
   and (r.status<>'CANCELLED' or r.closed_at>=v_end)
 ), debts as (
  select count(*) filter(where outstanding_ves>0.01) accounts,
   coalesce(sum(outstanding_ves),0) outstanding_ves,
   case when count(*) filter(where outstanding_ves>0.01 and factor is null)>0 then null
    else coalesce(sum(outstanding_ves*factor),0) end outstanding_bcv,
   count(*) filter(where outstanding_ves>0.01 and due_date<p_to) overdue
  from customer_debts
 ), cashea_opening as (
  select max(occurred_on) opening_on from public.cashea_balance_events
  where kind in ('OPENING_CREDIT','OPENING_DEBIT') and occurred_on<=p_to
   and (reversed_at is null or reversed_at>=v_end)
 ), cashea_ledger as (
  select b.opening_on,count(e.id) events,
   case when b.opening_on is null then null else coalesce(sum(e.amount_ref*
    case when e.kind in ('SERVICE_DEDUCTION','PAYOUT','OPENING_DEBIT','ADJUSTMENT_DEBIT') then -1 else 1 end),0) end recorded_ref
  from cashea_opening b left join public.cashea_balance_events e
   on e.occurred_on<=p_to and e.occurred_on>=b.opening_on
   and (e.reversed_at is null or e.reversed_at>=v_end)
  group by b.opening_on
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('period',jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'timezone','America/Caracas'),
  'generated_at',now(),'totals',jsonb_build_object('orders',s.orders,'gross_ves',round(s.gross_ves,2),
   'sales_equivalent',case when s.missing_rates>0 or s.overpaid>0 then null
    else round(s.cashea_bcv+s.contado_bcv+s.divisas_usd+s.credit_bcv,4) end),
  'channels',jsonb_build_object(
   'cashea',jsonb_build_object('orders',s.cashea_orders,'ves',round(s.cashea_ves,2),
    'equivalent',case when s.missing_rates>0 or s.overpaid>0 then null else round(s.cashea_bcv,4) end,
    'initial_ref',s.cashea_initial_ref,'financed_ref',s.cashea_financed_ref,'commission_ref',s.cashea_commission_ref),
   'contado',jsonb_build_object('orders',s.contado_orders,'ves',round(s.contado_ves,2),
    'equivalent',case when s.missing_rates>0 or s.overpaid>0 then null else round(s.contado_bcv,4) end),
   'divisas',jsonb_build_object('orders',s.divisas_orders,'usd',round(s.divisas_usd,4),'equivalent',round(s.divisas_usd,4)),
   'credito',jsonb_build_object('orders',s.credit_orders,'ves',round(s.credit_ves,2),
    'equivalent',case when s.missing_rates>0 or s.overpaid>0 then null else round(s.credit_bcv,4) end)),
  'receivables',jsonb_build_object('as_of',p_to,'accounts',d.accounts,'overdue',d.overdue,
   'outstanding_ves',round(d.outstanding_ves,2),'outstanding_bcv',round(d.outstanding_bcv,4),
   'cashea_recorded_ref',cl.recorded_ref,'cashea_opening_on',cl.opening_on,
   'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'order_id',x.order_id,'order_number',x.order_number,
    'customer',x.customer,'due_date',x.due_date,'outstanding_ves',round(x.outstanding_ves,2),
    'outstanding_bcv',round(x.outstanding_ves*x.factor,4)) order by x.due_date nulls last,x.order_number)
    from customer_debts x where x.outstanding_ves>0.01),'[]'::jsonb)),
  'orders',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'order_number',a.order_number,
   'business_at',a.business_at,'customer',a.customer,'plate',a.plate,'location',a.location,
   'channel',a.channel,'methods',a.methods,'total_ves',round(a.total_ves,2),
   'sales_equivalent',case when a.overpaid then null else round(a.cashea_bcv+a.contado_bcv+a.divisas_usd+a.credit_bcv,4) end,
   'cashea_bcv',round(a.cashea_bcv,4),'contado_bcv',round(a.contado_bcv,4),
   'divisas_usd',round(a.divisas_usd,4),'credit_bcv',round(a.credit_bcv,4))
   order by a.business_at desc,a.order_number desc) from allocated a),'[]'::jsonb),
  'warnings',jsonb_build_object('missing_invoice_rates',s.missing_rates,'overpaid_orders',s.overpaid,
   'excluded_cashea',(select count(*) from invoices where excluded)))
 into v_result from sales s cross join debts d cross join cashea_ledger cl;
 return v_result;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_quarantine_exact_duplicates()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r record; v_count integer:=0;
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.finance_require('ADMIN');
 for r in
  with active_allocations as (
   select external_transaction_id,count(*) n
   from public.reconciliation_allocations where reversed_at is null group by 1
  ), ranked as (
   select x.id,
     first_value(x.id) over(
       partition by x.source_id,x.occurred_at,x.reference,x.direction,x.currency,x.amount,
         x.amount_ref,x.assigned_ref,x.external_order,x.installments,x.provider_account
       order by (coalesce(a.n,0)>0) desc,x.created_at,x.id
     ) canonical_id,
     count(*) over(
       partition by x.source_id,x.occurred_at,x.reference,x.direction,x.currency,x.amount,
         x.amount_ref,x.assigned_ref,x.external_order,x.installments,x.provider_account
     ) group_size,
     sum(coalesce(a.n,0)) over(
       partition by x.source_id,x.occurred_at,x.reference,x.direction,x.currency,x.amount,
         x.amount_ref,x.assigned_ref,x.external_order,x.installments,x.provider_account
     ) allocated_rows
   from public.external_transactions x
   join public.external_sources s on s.id=x.source_id and s.provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS'
   left join active_allocations a on a.external_transaction_id=x.id
  )
  select id,canonical_id,group_size from ranked
  where group_size>1 and id<>canonical_id and allocated_rows<=1
    and not exists(select 1 from public.reconciliation_transaction_exclusions e where e.transaction_id=ranked.id)
  order by id
 loop
  insert into public.reconciliation_transaction_exclusions(transaction_id,canonical_transaction_id,reason,evidence,created_by)
  values(r.id,r.canonical_id,'EXACT_SOURCE_DUPLICATE',jsonb_build_object(
    'rule','same source, timestamp, reference, direction, currency, amounts, Cashea order, installments and provider account',
    'group_size',r.group_size
  ),auth.uid()) on conflict(transaction_id) do nothing;
  if found then
   update public.reconciliation_cases
   set status='DISMISSED',resolution='Fila repetida exacta; se conserva la transacción canónica '||r.canonical_id::text,
       resolved_by=auth.uid(),resolved_at=now(),updated_at=now()
   where subject_type='external_transaction' and subject_id=r.id and status='OPEN';
   insert into public.audit_events(event_type,entity_type,entity_id,data)
   values('finance.exact_duplicate_excluded','external_transaction',r.id,
     jsonb_build_object('canonical_transaction_id',r.canonical_id,'rule','EXACT_SOURCE_DUPLICATE'));
   v_count:=v_count+1;
  end if;
 end loop;
 return v_count;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_reference_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_prior_sale_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF tg_table_name = 'payments' THEN
    IF new.method IN ('TRANSFER_BDV','TRANSFER_BNC','MOBILE_PAYMENT')
       AND coalesce(btrim(new.reference),'') !~ '^\d{4,32}$' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Escribe al menos los últimos 4 números de la referencia bancaria';
    END IF;
    IF new.amount_original >= 'Infinity'::numeric THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Monto inválido';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF coalesce(btrim(new.cashea_reference),'') !~ '^\d{1,32}$' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Escribe el número de orden Cashea';
    END IF;
    new.cashea_reference := btrim(new.cashea_reference);
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(new.cashea_reference,22));

    -- All competing registrations must be cancelled AND tied to the same
    -- concrete customer+vehicle; customerless/walk-in orders cannot reuse.
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.cashea_sales previous
      JOIN public.orders old_order ON old_order.id=previous.order_id
      JOIN public.orders new_order ON new_order.id=new.order_id
      WHERE btrim(previous.cashea_reference)=new.cashea_reference
        AND previous.id IS DISTINCT FROM new.id
        AND NOT (
          previous.status='CANCELLED'
          AND old_order.status='CANCELLED'
          AND old_order.customer_id IS NOT NULL
          AND old_order.customer_id = new_order.customer_id
          AND old_order.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
          AND old_order.vehicle_id = new_order.vehicle_id
        )
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Este número de orden Cashea ya está vinculado a una venta activa o de otro cliente o vehículo';
    END IF;

    IF tg_op='INSERT' OR
       (tg_op='UPDATE' AND
        (old.cashea_reference IS DISTINCT FROM new.cashea_reference
         OR old.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.order_id)) THEN
      SELECT previous.id INTO v_prior_sale_id
      FROM public.cashea_sales previous
      JOIN public.orders old_order ON old_order.id=previous.order_id
      JOIN public.orders new_order ON new_order.id=new.order_id
      WHERE btrim(previous.cashea_reference)=new.cashea_reference
        AND previous.id IS DISTINCT FROM new.id
        AND previous.status='CANCELLED'
        AND old_order.status='CANCELLED'
        AND old_order.customer_id IS NOT NULL
        AND old_order.customer_id=new_order.customer_id
        AND old_order.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
        AND old_order.vehicle_id=new_order.vehicle_id
      ORDER BY previous.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1;

      IF v_prior_sale_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.audit_events(event_type,entity_type,entity_id,data)
        VALUES(
          'cashea.reference_reused_after_cancellation',
          'cashea_sale',
          new.id,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'cashea_reference',new.cashea_reference,
            'reused_from_sale_id',v_prior_sale_id,
            'new_order_id',new.order_id,
            'reason','Corrección de orden anulada; conservar ambos registros históricos'
          )
        );
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_sales_bcv(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_start timestamptz;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_report jsonb;
begin
  perform lubricenter_private.finance_require();
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>366 then
    raise exception 'Selecciona un período válido de máximo 367 días';
  end if;
  v_start := p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';
  v_end := (p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas';

  with invoice_lines as (
    select i.order_id,
      sum(i.charged_ves_amount) as line_ves,
      sum(i.charged_ves_amount/nullif(i.bcv_rate_snapshot,0)) as line_bcv,
      count(*) filter (where i.bcv_rate_snapshot is null or i.bcv_rate_snapshot<=0) as missing_rates
    from public.order_items i
    group by i.order_id
  ), invoice_payments as (
    -- Aggregate independently: joining individual payments to items would multiply the invoice.
    select p.order_id,
      coalesce(sum(p.value_ves) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) as usd_ves,
      coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) as usd_native,
      coalesce(sum(p.value_ves) filter(where p.currency='VES'),0) as ves_collected
    from public.payments p
    group by p.order_id
  ), invoices as (
    select o.id, o.total_ves, o.total_ref,
      coalesce(ip.usd_ves,0) usd_ves, coalesce(ip.usd_native,0) usd_native,
      coalesce(ip.ves_collected,0) ves_collected,
      coalesce(il.missing_rates,1) missing_rates,
      case when il.line_ves>0 and il.missing_rates=0
        then il.line_bcv/il.line_ves else null end as invoice_bcv_factor,
      (cs.id is not null) cashea,
      (cs.id is not null and cs.ownership_status<>'OWN') unknown_cashea
    from public.orders o
    left join invoice_lines il on il.order_id=o.id
    left join invoice_payments ip on ip.order_id=o.id
    left join public.cashea_sales cs on cs.order_id=o.id
    where o.status='CLOSED'
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)>=v_start
      and coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at)<v_end
  ), sums as (
    select
      count(*) filter (where not unknown_cashea) order_count,
      coalesce(sum(total_ref) filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) gross_ref,
      coalesce(sum(total_ves) filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) gross_ves,
      coalesce(sum(usd_native) filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) divisa_usd,
      coalesce(sum(usd_ves) filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) divisa_ves_equiv,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(total_ves-usd_ves,0))
        filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) billed_ves,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(total_ves-usd_ves,0)*invoice_bcv_factor)
        filter(where not unknown_cashea and invoice_bcv_factor is not null
          and usd_ves<=total_ves+0.01),0) billed_bcv,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(total_ves-usd_ves-ves_collected,0))
        filter(where not unknown_cashea),0) pending_ves,
      count(*) filter(where not unknown_cashea and missing_rates>0) missing_bcv_orders,
      count(*) filter(where not unknown_cashea and usd_ves>total_ves+0.01) usd_overpaid_orders,
      count(*) filter(where not unknown_cashea and cashea) cashea_orders,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(total_ves-usd_ves,0)*invoice_bcv_factor)
        filter(where not unknown_cashea and cashea and invoice_bcv_factor is not null),0) cashea_bcv,
      count(*) filter(where unknown_cashea) cashea_other_or_unresolved
    from invoices
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'period',jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to),
    'orders',order_count,
    'gross_ref',round(gross_ref,4),
    'gross_ves',round(gross_ves,2),
    'sales_ves',round(billed_ves,2),
    'sales_bcv',case when missing_bcv_orders>0 or usd_overpaid_orders>0 then null
      else round(billed_bcv,4) end,
    'sales_divisas_usd',round(divisa_usd,4),
    'pending_invoice_ves',round(pending_ves,2),
    'cashea_orders',cashea_orders,
    'cashea_sales_bcv',case when missing_bcv_orders>0 or usd_overpaid_orders>0
      then null else round(cashea_bcv,4) end,
    'warnings',jsonb_build_object('missing_order_bcv',missing_bcv_orders,
      'usd_overpayment',usd_overpaid_orders,
      'excluded_cashea_other_or_unresolved',cashea_other_or_unresolved)
  ) into v_report from sums;
  return v_report;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.finance_week_workbench(p_start date, p_lane text DEFAULT 'SUGGESTED'::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_end date:=p_start+6; v_rows jsonb; v_total integer; v_suggested integer; v_manual integer; v_auto integer; v_rule integer; v_excluded integer;
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.finance_require('ADMIN');
 if p_start is null or extract(isodow from p_start)<>1 or p_lane not in ('SUGGESTED','MANUAL') or p_offset<0 then raise exception 'Filtro semanal inválido'; end if;
 with allocation as (
  select external_transaction_id,sum(external_amount) used
  from public.reconciliation_allocations where reversed_at is null group by 1
 ), pending as (
  select x.*,s.provider,s.name source_name,fa.id account_id,fa.name account_name,
   case when s.provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' then least(x.amount_ref,x.assigned_ref) else x.amount end-coalesce(a.used,0) remaining,
   exists(select 1 from public.reconciliation_cases c where c.subject_type='external_transaction' and c.subject_id=x.id and c.status='OPEN' and c.kind in ('SOURCE_CONFLICT','SOURCE_AMOUNT')) source_conflict,
   exists(select 1 from public.cashea_order_snapshots os where os.external_order=x.external_order) has_order_snapshot
  from public.external_transactions x join public.external_sources s on s.id=x.source_id
  left join public.financial_accounts fa on fa.id=s.account_id
  left join allocation a on a.external_transaction_id=x.id
  where timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date between p_start and v_end
   and not exists(select 1 from public.reconciliation_transaction_exclusions e where e.transaction_id=x.id)
 ), triage as (
  select p.*,
   case
    when source_conflict then 'MANUAL'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' and has_order_snapshot then 'SUGGESTED'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' then 'MANUAL'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%TRASPASO%OTRAS CTAS%' then 'SUGGESTED'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and (upper(description) like '%TARJETA DE DEBITO%' or upper(description) like '%PAGOMOVIL%') then 'SUGGESTED'
    else 'MANUAL' end lane,
   case
    when source_conflict then 'SOURCE_CONFLICT'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' and has_order_snapshot then 'CONFIRM_CASHEA_OWNERSHIP'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' then 'VERIFY_CASHEA_OWNERSHIP'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%TRASPASO%OTRAS CTAS%' then 'CONFIRM_INTERNAL_TRANSFER'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%TARJETA DE DEBITO%' then 'CONFIRM_EXPENSE'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%PAGOMOVIL%' then 'CONFIRM_EXPENSE'
    when direction='IN' then 'LINK_INCOME'
    else 'CLASSIFY_MANUALLY' end suggested_action,
   case
    when source_conflict then 'El archivo contradice otra evidencia del mismo movimiento.'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' and has_order_snapshot then 'La misma orden aparece en el archivo Cashea de órdenes; confirma antes de atribuirla.'
    when ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' then 'No existe una orden interna ni otra prueba suficiente de propiedad.'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%TRASPASO%OTRAS CTAS%' then 'El banco la identifica como transferencia; falta confirmar la cuenta contraparte.'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%TARJETA DE DEBITO%' then 'El medio indica compra con tarjeta; falta confirmar categoría y finalidad.'
    when provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and upper(description) like '%PAGOMOVIL%' then 'El medio indica pago móvil; falta confirmar beneficiario y categoría.'
    when direction='IN' then 'No existe una coincidencia única por referencia, cuenta, fecha e importe.'
    else 'No hay evidencia suficiente para automatizar.' end suggestion_reason
  from pending p where remaining>case when provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' then .005 else .01 end
 ), numbered as (
  select *,row_number() over(order by occurred_at,id) rn from triage where lane=p_lane
 )
 select count(*)::integer,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'id',id,'provider',provider,'source_name',source_name,'account_id',account_id,'account_name',account_name,
   'occurred_at',occurred_at,'reference',reference,'description',description,'direction',direction,'currency',currency,
   'amount',amount,'amount_ref',amount_ref,'remaining',remaining,'external_order',external_order,'installments',installments,
   'ownership_status',ownership_status,'nature',nature,'category',category,'category_id',category_id,
   'lane',lane,'suggested_action',suggested_action,'suggestion_reason',suggestion_reason
  ) order by occurred_at,id) filter(where rn>p_offset and rn<=p_offset+50),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_total,v_rows from numbered;

 with allocation as (select external_transaction_id,sum(external_amount) used from public.reconciliation_allocations where reversed_at is null group by 1), base as (
  select x.*,s.provider,coalesce(a.used,0) used,
   exists(select 1 from public.reconciliation_cases c where c.subject_type='external_transaction' and c.subject_id=x.id and c.status='OPEN' and c.kind in ('SOURCE_CONFLICT','SOURCE_AMOUNT')) conflict,
   exists(select 1 from public.cashea_order_snapshots os where os.external_order=x.external_order) snap
  from public.external_transactions x join public.external_sources s on s.id=x.source_id left join allocation a on a.external_transaction_id=x.id
  where timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date between p_start and v_end and not exists(select 1 from public.reconciliation_transaction_exclusions e where e.transaction_id=x.id)
 ), remaining as (
  select *,case when provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' then least(amount_ref,assigned_ref) else amount end-used rem from base
 ), lanes as (
  select case when not conflict and ((ownership_status='UNRESOLVED' and snap) or (ownership_status<>'UNRESOLVED' and provider='BDV' and direction='OUT' and (upper(description) like '%TRASPASO%OTRAS CTAS%' or upper(description) like '%TARJETA DE DEBITO%' or upper(description) like '%PAGOMOVIL%'))) then 'SUGGESTED' else 'MANUAL' end lane
  from remaining where rem>case when provider='CASHEA_TRANSACTIONS' then .005 else .01 end
 ) select count(*) filter(where lane='SUGGESTED'),count(*) filter(where lane='MANUAL') into v_suggested,v_manual from lanes;
  select count(distinct a.external_transaction_id) filter(where x.nature<>'BANK_FEE'),
   count(distinct a.external_transaction_id) filter(where x.nature='BANK_FEE') into v_auto,v_rule
  from public.reconciliation_allocations a join public.external_transactions x on x.id=a.external_transaction_id
   where a.reversed_at is null and a.method in ('EXACT','ROUNDING') and timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date between p_start and v_end;
 select count(*) into v_excluded from public.reconciliation_transaction_exclusions e join public.external_transactions x on x.id=e.transaction_id
  where timezone('America/Caracas',x.occurred_at)::date between p_start and v_end;
 return jsonb_build_object('start',p_start,'end',v_end,'lane',p_lane,'total',v_total,'rows',v_rows,
   'counts',jsonb_build_object('AUTO_EXACT',v_auto,'AUTO_RULE',v_rule,'SUGGESTED',v_suggested,'MANUAL',v_manual,'EXCLUDED_DUPLICATE',v_excluded),
  'categories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'nature',nature) order by nature,name) from public.finance_categories where active),'[]'::jsonb),
  'accounts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'code',code,'name',name,'currency',currency) order by code) from public.financial_accounts where active),'[]'::jsonb));
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.inventory_item_history(p_inventory_item_id uuid, p_location_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.occurred_at desc,x.id desc) from (
   select m.id,m.quantity_delta,m.movement_type,m.note,m.occurred_at,l.name location_name,
     ri.unit_cost_ref,ri.average_cost_before,ri.average_cost_after,
     r.supplier_invoice_id,i.invoice_number
   from public.inventory_movements m join public.locations l on l.id=m.location_id
   left join public.supplier_receipt_items ri on ri.id=m.supplier_receipt_item_id
   left join public.supplier_receipts r on r.id=ri.supplier_receipt_id
   left join public.supplier_invoices i on i.id=r.supplier_invoice_id
   where m.inventory_item_id=p_inventory_item_id and m.location_id=p_location_id
   order by m.occurred_at desc,m.id desc limit 100
 ) x),'[]'::jsonb);
end $function$;

 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql

  select coalesce(
    (select sum(i.charged_ves_amount) / nullif(sum(i.agreed_usd), 0)
       from public.order_items i where i.order_id = p_order_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.order_integrity_audit()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; ceiling bigint;
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 select greatest(last_number,(select coalesce(max(order_seq),0) from public.orders)) into ceiling from lubricenter_private.order_number_counter where singleton;
 with deleted as (
  select distinct on(data->>'order_number') (substring(data->>'order_number' from '[0-9]+'))::bigint n,data->>'reason' reason,created_at,actor_id
  from public.audit_events where event_type='ORDER_DELETED' and data->>'order_number' ~ '^OS-[0-9]+$' order by data->>'order_number',created_at desc
 ), sequence as (
  select s.n,coalesce(o.order_number,'OS-'||lpad(s.n::text,6,'0')) order_number,o.id order_id,o.status,o.created_at,o.opened_at,o.closed_at,
   case when o.id is not null then 'EXISTS' when d.n is not null then 'DELETED' when e.number is not null then e.classification else 'UNEXPLAINED' end classification,
   case when o.id is not null then coalesce(o.cancellation_reason,'Orden conservada en el sistema') when d.n is not null then d.reason when e.number is not null then e.explanation else 'No existe orden ni evidencia persistente suficiente para atribuir una causa. No equivale a una venta perdida comprobada.' end explanation,
   d.created_at deleted_at,d.actor_id deleted_by
  from generate_series(1,ceiling) s(n) left join public.orders o on o.order_seq=s.n left join deleted d on d.n=s.n left join lubricenter_private.order_number_explanations e on e.number=s.n
 ), ledger as (
  select i.id,i.order_id,i.quantity,o.order_number,o.status,coalesce(sum(m.quantity_delta) filter(where m.movement_type='SALE'),0) sale,
   coalesce(sum(m.quantity_delta) filter(where m.movement_type='RETURN'),0) returned,count(m.id) filter(where m.movement_type='SALE') sale_count,ii.sku
  from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id join public.inventory_items ii on ii.id=i.inventory_item_id
  left join public.inventory_movements m on m.order_item_id=i.id group by i.id,o.id,ii.id
 ) select jsonb_build_object(
  'generated_at',now(),'last_number',ceiling,
  'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('existing',count(*) filter(where classification='EXISTS'),'closed',count(*) filter(where status='CLOSED'),
   'open',count(*) filter(where status='OPEN'),'cancelled',count(*) filter(where status='CANCELLED'),'deleted',count(*) filter(where classification='DELETED'),
   'tests',count(*) filter(where classification='TEST_ROLLBACK_CONFIRMED'),'unexplained',count(*) filter(where classification='UNEXPLAINED')) from sequence),
  'sequence',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s order by n),'[]'::jsonb) from sequence s),
  'inventory_anomalies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]'::jsonb) from (select * from ledger where status='CLOSED' and (sale<>-quantity or returned<>0 or sale_count<>1) or status in ('OPEN','CANCELLED') and sale+returned<>0)x),
  'negative_stock',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]'::jsonb) from (select ii.id,ii.sku,ii.description,ii.needs_review,l.code location,sum(m.quantity_delta) quantity,
   sum(m.quantity_delta) filter(where m.movement_type='OPENING_IMPORT') opening,min(m.created_at) first_movement
   from public.inventory_movements m join public.inventory_items ii on ii.id=m.inventory_item_id join public.locations l on l.id=m.location_id group by ii.id,l.id having sum(m.quantity_delta)<0)x),
  'untracked_items',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by order_number),'[]'::jsonb) from (select o.order_number,o.id order_id,i.id item_id,i.description,i.quantity,i.pricing_mode,
   (select count(*) from public.inventory_items ii where ii.product_id=i.product_id and ii.active) candidate_count,
   (select string_agg(ii.sku,', ' order by ii.sku) from public.inventory_items ii where ii.product_id=i.product_id and ii.active) candidate_skus
   from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id where o.status='CLOSED' and i.item_type='PRODUCT' and i.inventory_item_id is null)x),
  'deleted_payments',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]'::jsonb) from (
   select a.data->>'order_number' order_number,h.before_data->>'method' method,h.before_data->>'currency' currency,
    (h.before_data->>'amount_original')::numeric amount,h.before_data->>'paid_at' paid_at,h.recorded_at removed_at,a.created_at order_deleted_at,
    case when abs(extract(epoch from h.recorded_at-a.created_at))<1 then 'Coincide con la eliminación de la orden' else 'Pago retirado antes de eliminar la orden' end evidence,
    (select string_agg(o.order_number,', ' order by o.order_seq) from public.orders o where o.customer_id=(select (z.before_data->>'customer_id')::uuid from public.order_history z where z.order_id=h.order_id and z.entity_type='orders' and z.action='DELETE' order by z.recorded_at desc limit 1) and o.created_at>=a.created_at and o.created_at<a.created_at+interval '7 days') later_orders
   from public.order_history h join public.audit_events a on a.entity_id=h.order_id and a.event_type='ORDER_DELETED'
   where h.entity_type='payments' and h.action='DELETE' and not exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=h.order_id)
  )x),
  'movements',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by created_at),'[]'::jsonb) from (select o.order_number,o.status,ii.sku,m.id,m.quantity_delta,m.movement_type,m.reversal_of,m.note,m.created_at,m.occurred_at
   from public.inventory_movements m join public.order_items i on i.id=m.order_item_id join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id join public.inventory_items ii on ii.id=m.inventory_item_id where m.movement_type in ('SALE','RETURN'))x)
 ) into result;
 return result;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.payroll_admin_week_history(p_end date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE p_start date; response jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 IF p_end IS NULL OR extract(isodow from p_end)<>6 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selecciona el sábado que cierra la semana de nómina';
 END IF;
 p_start:=p_end-5;
 WITH runs AS (
   SELECT r.*,e.name employee_name FROM public.payroll_runs r
   JOIN public.employees e ON e.id=r.employee_id
   WHERE r.period_start=p_start AND r.period_end=p_end AND r.status='SETTLED'
 ), run_cards AS (
   SELECT r.*,
     coalesce((SELECT sum(p.usd_equivalent) FROM public.payroll_payments p WHERE p.payroll_run_id=r.id),0) paid_usd,
     coalesce((SELECT sum(x.usd_applied) FROM public.payroll_advance_applications x WHERE x.payroll_run_id=r.id),0) advance_applied_usd,
     coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'id',a.id,'employee_id',a.employee_id,'paid_on',a.paid_on,'usd_equivalent',a.usd_equivalent,
       'applied_usd',x.usd_applied,'currency',a.currency,'amount_original',a.amount_original,
       'account_code',fa.code,'reference',a.reference,'note',a.note,'movement_id',a.account_movement_id
      ) ORDER BY a.paid_on,a.id)
      FROM public.payroll_advance_applications x
      JOIN public.payroll_advances a ON a.id=x.advance_id
      JOIN public.financial_accounts fa ON fa.id=a.account_id WHERE x.payroll_run_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb) advances,
     coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'id',p.id,'paid_on',p.paid_on,'currency',p.currency,'amount_original',p.amount_original,
       'usd_equivalent',p.usd_equivalent,'payment_mode',p.payment_mode,'component',p.component,
       'reference',p.reference,'note',p.note,'account_code',fa.code,
       'ledger_movement_id',p.account_movement_id,'created_at',p.created_at
       ) ORDER BY p.paid_on,p.created_at)
       FROM public.payroll_payments p LEFT JOIN public.financial_accounts fa ON fa.id=p.account_id
       WHERE p.payroll_run_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb) payments,
     (SELECT a.data FROM public.audit_events a WHERE a.event_type='payroll.settlement_admin_snapshot'
      AND a.entity_id=r.id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) admin_snapshot
   FROM runs r
 ), work_rows AS (
   SELECT r.id run_id,r.employee_id,w.id work_id,
     w.order_id,w.order_number,w.description,w.source_type,w.payout_mode,
     w.earned_at,w.created_at,w.payroll_run_id current_run_id,
     (w.payroll_run_id=r.id) settled_in_run,
     (w.created_at>r.created_at) recorded_after_settlement,
     CASE WHEN next_history.before_data IS NOT NULL THEN next_history.before_data
       WHEN prior_history.after_data IS NOT NULL THEN prior_history.after_data
       ELSE to_jsonb(w) END snapshot,
     coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'occurred_at',h.occurred_at,'reason',h.reason,
       'before_decision',h.before_data->>'decision','after_decision',h.after_data->>'decision',
       'before_amount',h.before_data->>'obligation_usd','after_amount',h.after_data->>'obligation_usd',
       'before_reason',h.before_data->>'reason','after_reason',h.after_data->>'reason'
       ) ORDER BY h.occurred_at)
       FROM public.payroll_work_history h WHERE h.work_item_id=w.id),'[]'::jsonb) timeline
   FROM runs r
   JOIN public.payroll_work_items w ON w.employee_id=r.employee_id
      AND (w.payroll_run_id=r.id OR
        (w.earned_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end)
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.before_data FROM public.payroll_work_history h
     WHERE h.work_item_id=w.id AND h.occurred_at>r.created_at
     ORDER BY h.occurred_at ASC LIMIT 1) next_history ON true
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.after_data FROM public.payroll_work_history h
     WHERE h.work_item_id=w.id AND h.occurred_at<=r.created_at
     ORDER BY h.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1) prior_history ON true
 ), adjustment_rows AS (
   SELECT r.id run_id,a.id,a.amount_ref,a.adjustment_type,a.note,a.decision,a.occurred_on,
       a.payroll_run_id,a.created_at,(a.created_at>r.created_at) recorded_after_settlement
   FROM runs r
   JOIN public.payroll_adjustments a ON a.employee_id=r.employee_id
     AND (a.payroll_run_id=r.id OR
       (a.occurred_on BETWEEN p_start AND p_end))
 ), cards AS (
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'id',r.id,'employee_id',r.employee_id,'employee_name',r.employee_name,
   'period_start',r.period_start,'period_end',r.period_end,
   'created_at',r.created_at,'status',r.status,'payroll_version',r.payroll_version,
   'fixed_ref',r.fixed_ref,'variable_ref',r.variable_ref,'adjustments_ref',r.adjustments_ref,
   'total_ref',r.total_ref,'paid_usd',r.paid_usd,'advances_applied_usd',r.advance_applied_usd,
   'outstanding_usd',greatest(r.total_ref-r.paid_usd-r.advance_applied_usd,0),
   'advances',r.advances,
   'payments',r.payments,'admin_snapshot',r.admin_snapshot,
   'work',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'id',w.work_id,'order_id',w.order_id,'order_number',w.order_number,
       'description',w.description,'source_type',w.source_type,'payout_mode',w.payout_mode,
       'earned_at',w.earned_at,'decision_at_settlement',
          CASE WHEN w.recorded_after_settlement THEN 'LATE_POSTING'
             ELSE coalesce(w.snapshot->>'decision','UNKNOWN') END,
       'reason_at_settlement',CASE WHEN w.recorded_after_settlement
           THEN 'Trabajo registrado después de la liquidación original'
           ELSE w.snapshot->>'reason' END,
       'amount_at_settlement',CASE WHEN w.recorded_after_settlement THEN 0
           ELSE coalesce((w.snapshot->>'obligation_usd')::numeric,0) END,
       'current_payroll_run_id',w.current_run_id,
       'settled_in_this_run',w.settled_in_run,'late_posting',w.recorded_after_settlement,
       'carried_from_prior_week',(w.earned_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date<p_start,
       'timeline',w.timeline
       ) ORDER BY w.earned_at,w.work_id)
     FROM work_rows w WHERE w.run_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),
   'adjustments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',a.id,'type',a.adjustment_type,'amount_ref',a.amount_ref,
      'note',a.note,'decision',a.decision,'occurred_on',a.occurred_on,
      'included_in_run',a.payroll_run_id=r.id,'late_posting',a.recorded_after_settlement
      ) ORDER BY a.occurred_on,a.id)
     FROM adjustment_rows a WHERE a.run_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
   ) ORDER BY r.employee_name) AS list FROM run_cards r
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('start',p_start,'end',p_end,'runs',coalesce(cards.list,'[]'::jsonb))
 INTO response FROM cards;
 RETURN response;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lubricenter_private.payroll_sync()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(240924,1);
 perform 1 FROM public.orders o WHERE EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_work_items w WHERE w.order_id=o.id
  ) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items i JOIN public.payroll_accruals a
      ON a.source_order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.order_id=o.id AND a.payroll_run_id IS NULL
  ) ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE;
 insert into public.payroll_work_items(
   accrual_id,payment_id,employee_id,order_id,order_number,description,source_type,
   currency,original_amount,amount,ref_per_unit,obligation_usd,payout_mode,earned_at
 )
 select a.id,p.id,a.employee_id,o.id,o.order_number,coalesce(a.description,i.description),
   a.source_type,p.currency,
   round(p.amount_original*a.amount_ref*i.bcv_rate_snapshot/o.total_ves,2),
   round(p.amount_original*a.amount_ref*i.bcv_rate_snapshot/o.total_ves,2),
   p.value_ref/p.amount_original,
   round((case when i.price_denomination='USD'
      then a.amount_ref*i.bcv_rate_snapshot/nullif(i.operative_rate_snapshot,0)
      else a.amount_ref end)*p.value_ves/nullif(o.total_ves,0),2),
   case when p.currency='USD' then 'HARD_USD' else 'BCV_VES' end,
   greatest(a.occurred_at,p.paid_at)
 from public.payroll_accruals a
 join public.order_items i on i.id=a.source_order_item_id
 join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id
 join public.payments p on p.order_id=o.id
 where a.payroll_run_id is null and o.status='CLOSED' and o.total_ves>0
   and p.amount_original>0 and p.value_ref>0 and p.value_ves>0
 on conflict(accrual_id,payment_id) where reversal_of is null do nothing;

 insert into public.payroll_work_items(
  accrual_id,payment_id,employee_id,order_id,order_number,description,source_type,
  currency,original_amount,amount,ref_per_unit,obligation_usd,payout_mode,earned_at,reversal_of,reason
 )
 select w.accrual_id,w.payment_id,w.employee_id,w.order_id,w.order_number,
  'Reversión · '||w.description,w.source_type,w.currency,
  -w.amount,-w.amount,w.ref_per_unit,
  -abs(coalesce(w.obligation_usd,case when w.currency='USD' then w.amount else w.amount*w.ref_per_unit end)),
  coalesce(w.payout_mode,case when w.currency='USD' then 'HARD_USD' else 'BCV_VES' end),
  now(),w.id,'Orden anulada o cobro/trabajo corregido'
 from public.payroll_work_items w
 where w.payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL AND w.reversal_of IS NULL AND w.decision='PAY'
  AND w.amount<>0 AND (
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_accruals a WHERE a.id=w.accrual_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payments p WHERE p.id=w.payment_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o WHERE o.id=w.order_id AND o.status='CLOSED')
  )
 on conflict(reversal_of) where reversal_of is not null do nothing;

 update public.payroll_work_items w
 set decision='EXCLUDE',reason='Orden anulada o cobro/trabajo corregido',version=version+1
 where w.payroll_run_id IS NULL AND w.reversal_of IS NULL AND w.decision<>'EXCLUDE'
  AND (
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_accruals a WHERE a.id=w.accrual_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payments p WHERE p.id=w.payment_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o WHERE o.id=w.order_id AND o.status='CLOSED')
  );
 -- Future cash collection is still recognized in payments and Cashea installments;
 -- this only excludes the second wage on a covered commission.
 update public.payroll_work_items w
 set decision='EXCLUDE',
     reason='Comisión ya cubierta por adelanto Cashea (no volver a pagar esta cuota)',
     version=w.version+1
 from public.cashea_payroll_policies pol
 join public.payroll_adjustments adj ON adj.id=pol.advance_adjustment_id
 where w.accrual_id=pol.accrual_id AND pol.mode='FULL_UPFRONT'
   AND adj.decision='PAY'
   AND w.payroll_run_id IS NULL AND w.reversal_of IS NULL
   AND w.decision='PAY'
   AND w.created_at>pol.selected_at;
end
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.capture_service_records_on_close()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE rec record; v_next_km integer;v_next_date date;
BEGIN
 IF new.status='CLOSED' AND old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED' THEN
  INSERT INTO public.service_records(
    order_id,order_item_id,customer_id,vehicle_id,service_type,description,odometer,
    oil_brand,oil_viscosity,oil_quantity_liters,oil_filter_code,
    next_service_odometer,next_service_date,charged_ref_amount,charged_ves_amount,
    performed_at,created_by
  )
  SELECT new.id,oi.id,coalesce(v.customer_id,new.customer_id),v.id,
   CASE WHEN oi.business_area in('OIL_CHANGE','WORKSHOP','ELECTROAUTO')
        THEN oi.business_area ELSE 'OTHER' END,
   oi.description,coalesce(oi.service_odometer,v.current_odometer),
   oi.oil_brand,oi.oil_viscosity,oi.oil_quantity_liters,oi.oil_filter_code,
   oi.next_service_odometer,oi.next_service_date,oi.charged_ref_amount,
   oi.charged_ves_amount,coalesce(new.closed_at,now()),new.created_by
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.vehicles v ON v.id=coalesce(oi.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id)
  WHERE oi.order_id=new.id AND oi.item_type='SERVICE'
  ON CONFLICT(order_item_id) DO NOTHING;

  FOR rec IN SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(oi.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_id
   FROM public.order_items oi
   WHERE oi.order_id=new.id AND oi.item_type='SERVICE' AND
     coalesce(oi.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id) IS NOT NULL
  LOOP
   UPDATE public.vehicles v SET
    current_odometer=greatest(coalesce(v.current_odometer,0),
     coalesce((SELECT max(i.service_odometer) FROM public.order_items i
       WHERE i.order_id=new.id AND i.item_type='SERVICE'
         AND coalesce(i.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id)=rec.vehicle_id
         AND i.service_odometer IS NOT NULL),0)),
    updated_at=now()
   WHERE v.id=rec.vehicle_id AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=new.id
       AND i.item_type='SERVICE' AND coalesce(i.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id)=rec.vehicle_id
       AND i.service_odometer IS NOT NULL);
   v_next_km:=null;v_next_date:=null;
   SELECT i.next_service_odometer,i.next_service_date INTO v_next_km,v_next_date
   FROM public.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=new.id AND i.item_type='SERVICE'
     AND i.business_area='OIL_CHANGE'
     AND coalesce(i.service_vehicle_id,new.vehicle_id)=rec.vehicle_id
   ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 1;
   INSERT INTO public.integration_events(event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,payload)
   VALUES('vehicle.service_history_updated','vehicle',rec.vehicle_id,
     jsonb_build_object('order_id',new.id,'order_number',new.order_number,
       'customer_id',new.customer_id,'vehicle_id',rec.vehicle_id,
       'next_service_odometer',v_next_km,
       'next_service_date',v_next_date,
       'has_oil_change',v_next_km is not null OR v_next_date is not null));
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 RETURN new;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cashea_surcharge_percent(p_initial_percent numeric DEFAULT 40)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select round(100 * (1 / nullif(1
      - lubricenter_private.setting_number('cashea_commission_percent', 4) / 100
      - greatest(0, 1 - coalesce(p_initial_percent, 40) / 100)
        * lubricenter_private.setting_number('cashea_opportunity_monthly_percent', 5) / 100
