CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_overview()
 RETURNS TABLE(local_date date, closed_orders_today bigint, sales_ves_today numeric, sales_ref_today numeric, collected_ves_today numeric, collected_ref_today numeric, open_orders bigint, active_vehicles bigint, vehicles_received bigint, vehicles_diagnosis bigint, vehicles_in_progress bigint, vehicles_waiting_parts bigint, vehicles_ready bigint, post_service_action bigint, maintenance_due bigint, maintenance_soon bigint, receivables_open bigint, receivables_outstanding_ves numeric, payroll_pending_ref numeric, inventory_review bigint, inventory_negative bigint, bcv_rate numeric, operative_rate numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_today date := (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date;
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  return query
  with rates as (select * from public.current_exchange_rates),
  workshop as (
    select
      count(*)::bigint active,
      count(*) filter(where workflow_status='RECEIVED')::bigint received,
      count(*) filter(where workflow_status='DIAGNOSIS')::bigint diagnosis,
      count(*) filter(where workflow_status='IN_PROGRESS')::bigint in_progress,
      count(*) filter(where workflow_status='WAITING_PARTS')::bigint waiting_parts,
      count(*) filter(where workflow_status='READY')::bigint ready
    from public.workshop_board_current
  )
  select
    v_today,
    (select count(*) from public.orders where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=v_today),
    (select coalesce(sum(total_ves),0) from public.orders where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=v_today),
    (select coalesce(sum(total_ref),0) from public.orders where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=v_today),
    (select coalesce(sum(value_ves),0) from public.payments where method not in ('CUSTOMER_BALANCE_USD','CUSTOMER_BALANCE_BCV') and exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=payments.order_id and o.status<>'CANCELLED') and (paid_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=v_today),
    (select coalesce(sum(value_ref),0) from public.payments where method not in ('CUSTOMER_BALANCE_USD','CUSTOMER_BALANCE_BCV') and exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=payments.order_id and o.status<>'CANCELLED') and (paid_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=v_today),
    (select count(*) from public.orders where status='OPEN'),
    workshop.active,workshop.received,workshop.diagnosis,workshop.in_progress,workshop.waiting_parts,workshop.ready,
    (select count(*) from public.customer_followups where followup_type='POST_SERVICE' and (status='PENDING' or (status='SNOOZED' and (snoozed_until is null or snoozed_until<=v_today)))),
    (select count(*) from public.maintenance_reminders_current where urgency='DUE'),
    (select count(*) from public.maintenance_reminders_current where urgency='SOON'),
    (select count(*) from public.receivables where status='OPEN'),
    (select coalesce(sum(outstanding_ves),0) from public.receivables where status='OPEN'),
    (select coalesce(sum(amount_ref),0) from public.payroll_accruals where payroll_run_id is null),
    (select count(*) from public.inventory_current where needs_review=true),
    (select count(*) from public.inventory_current where quantity_on_hand<0),
    rates.bcv_rate,rates.operative_rate
  from workshop cross join rates;
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_today()
 RETURNS TABLE(orders_today bigint, sales_ves numeric, sales_ref numeric, open_orders bigint, payroll_pending_ref numeric, bcv_rate numeric, operative_rate numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with d as (select (now() at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date as today),
  r as (select * from public.current_exchange_rates)
  select
    (select count(*) from public.orders,d where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=d.today),
    (select coalesce(sum(total_ves),0) from public.orders,d where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=d.today),
    (select coalesce(sum(total_ref),0) from public.orders,d where status='CLOSED' and (closed_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date=d.today),
    (select count(*) from public.orders where status='OPEN'),
    (select coalesce(sum(amount_ref),0) from public.payroll_accruals where payroll_run_id is null),
    r.bcv_rate,
    r.operative_rate
  from r;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_dashboard(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_from date := coalesce(p_from, date_trunc('month', timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date);
  v_to date := coalesce(p_to, timezone('America/Caracas', now())::date);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  if v_from > v_to then raise exception 'La fecha inicial debe ser anterior a la final'; end if;
  if v_to - v_from > 366 then raise exception 'El período máximo es de 367 días'; end if;

  with classified_sales as (
    select o.id, o.total_ref, o.total_ves,
      timezone('America/Caracas', coalesce(o.business_at, o.closed_at))::date sale_date,
      case when cs.id is not null then 'CASHEA'
           when r.id is not null then 'CREDIT_LC'
           else 'CASH' end sale_type
    from public.orders o
    left join public.cashea_sales cs on cs.order_id = o.id
    left join public.receivables r on r.order_id = o.id and r.debtor_type <> 'CASHEA'
    where o.status = 'CLOSED'
      and coalesce(o.business_at, o.closed_at) >= (v_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      and coalesce(o.business_at, o.closed_at) < ((v_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  ), sales_summary as (
    select count(*) orders, coalesce(sum(total_ref),0) total_ref, coalesce(sum(total_ves),0) total_ves
    from classified_sales
  ), sales_by_type as (
    select sale_type, count(*) orders, coalesce(sum(total_ref),0) total_ref, coalesce(sum(total_ves),0) total_ves
    from classified_sales group by sale_type
  ), period_payments as (
    select p.* from public.payments p
    where p.method not in ('CUSTOMER_BALANCE_USD','CUSTOMER_BALANCE_BCV')
      and exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=p.order_id and o.status<>'CANCELLED')
      and p.paid_at >= (v_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      and p.paid_at < ((v_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  ), collections_summary as (
    select count(*) payments, coalesce(sum(value_ref),0) total_ref, coalesce(sum(value_ves),0) total_ves
    from period_payments
  ), collections_by_method as (
    select method, count(*) payments, coalesce(sum(value_ref),0) total_ref, coalesce(sum(value_ves),0) total_ves
    from period_payments group by method
  ), customer_balance_cash as (
    select coalesce(sum(value_ves) filter(where category='CUSTOMER_BALANCE_DEPOSIT'),0) deposits_ves,
      coalesce(sum(value_ves) filter(where category='CUSTOMER_BALANCE_REFUND'),0) refunds_ves,
      coalesce(sum(value_ves) filter(where category='CUSTOMER_BALANCE_OVERPAYMENT_REVERSAL'),0) reversals_ves
    from public.account_movements
    where category in ('CUSTOMER_BALANCE_DEPOSIT','CUSTOMER_BALANCE_REFUND',
      'CUSTOMER_BALANCE_OVERPAYMENT_REVERSAL')
      and occurred_at >= (v_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      and occurred_at < ((v_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  ), retained_cancelled_cash as (
    select coalesce(sum(p.value_ves),0) retained_ves
    from public.customer_balance_movements cb join public.payments p on p.id=cb.payment_id
    where cb.origin='CANCELLED_SALE'
      and p.paid_at >= (v_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      and p.paid_at < ((v_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  ), period_expenses as (
    select am.* from public.account_movements am
    where am.direction='OUT' and am.movement_type='EXPENSE'
      and am.occurred_at >= (v_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
      and am.occurred_at < ((v_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas')
  ), expense_summary as (
    select count(*) expenses, coalesce(sum(value_ves),0) total_ves from period_expenses
  ), expenses_by_category as (
    select coalesce(category,'Sin categoría') category, count(*) expenses, coalesce(sum(value_ves),0) total_ves
    from period_expenses group by coalesce(category,'Sin categoría')
  ), daily as (
    select d::date activity_date,
      coalesce((select sum(s.total_ref) from classified_sales s where s.sale_date=d::date),0) sales_ref,
      coalesce((select sum(p.value_ref) from period_payments p where timezone('America/Caracas',p.paid_at)::date=d::date),0) collected_ref,
      coalesce((select sum(e.value_ves) from period_expenses e where timezone('America/Caracas',e.occurred_at)::date=d::date),0) expenses_ves
    from generate_series(v_from::timestamp, v_to::timestamp, interval '1 day') d
  ), lc_open as (
    select count(*) accounts, coalesce(sum(outstanding_ves),0) outstanding_ves,
      count(*) filter(where due_date is not null and due_date < timezone('America/Caracas',now())::date) overdue
    from public.receivables where status='OPEN' and debtor_type <> 'CASHEA'
  ), cashea_open as (
    select count(distinct cs.id) sales,
      count(ci.id) filter(where ci.status in ('PENDING','PARTIAL')) installments,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(ci.amount_ref-ci.paid_ref,0)) filter(where ci.status in ('PENDING','PARTIAL')),0) outstanding_ref,
      count(ci.id) filter(where ci.status in ('PENDING','PARTIAL') and ci.due_date < timezone('America/Caracas',now())::date) overdue
    from public.cashea_sales cs left join public.cashea_installments ci on ci.cashea_sale_id=cs.id
    where cs.status <> 'SETTLED'
  ), balances as (
    select id,code,name,currency,account_type,balance_native,balance_ves
    from public.account_balances_current where active order by account_type,name
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from',v_from,'to',v_to,'days',v_to-v_from+1),
    'sales', (select to_jsonb(sales_summary) from sales_summary),
    'sales_by_type', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by sale_type) from sales_by_type x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'collections', (select to_jsonb(collections_summary) from collections_summary),
    'collections_by_method', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by total_ves desc) from collections_by_method x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'customer_balance_cash', (select to_jsonb(customer_balance_cash) from customer_balance_cash),
    'retained_cancelled_cash_ves', (select retained_ves from retained_cancelled_cash),
    'expenses', (select to_jsonb(expense_summary) from expense_summary),
    'expenses_by_category', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by total_ves desc) from expenses_by_category x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'net_cash_ves', (select total_ves from collections_summary)
      + (select deposits_ves-refunds_ves-reversals_ves from customer_balance_cash)
      + (select retained_ves from retained_cancelled_cash)
      - (select total_ves from expense_summary),
    'lc_open', (select to_jsonb(lc_open) from lc_open),
    'cashea_open', (select to_jsonb(cashea_open) from cashea_open),
    'accounts', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from balances x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'daily', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by activity_date) from daily x),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;
  return v_result;
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_profit_report(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v jsonb;
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from > p_to or p_to - p_from > 400 then
    raise exception 'Rango de fechas inválido';
  end if;
  with e as (
    select x.*, round(x.revenue_ref - x.cost_ref - x.mechanics_ref - x.cashea_commission_ref, 4) as profit_ref,
      (x.business_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date as day
    from public.order_line_economics x
    where (x.business_at at time zone 'America/Caracas')::date between p_from and p_to
  ), areas as (
    select area,
      round(sum(revenue_ref), 2) revenue_ref, round(sum(cost_ref), 2) cost_ref,
      round(sum(mechanics_ref), 2) mechanics_ref, round(sum(cashea_commission_ref), 2) cashea_commission_ref,
      round(sum(profit_ref), 2) profit_ref, count(*) lines, count(distinct order_id) orders,
      round(sum(cost_ref) filter (where cost_estimated), 2) estimated_cost_ref,
      round(sum(revenue_ref) filter (where line_role = 'PASS_THROUGH'), 2) pass_through_revenue_ref
    from e group by area
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
    'areas', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(area, to_jsonb(a) - 'area') from areas a), '{}'::jsonb),
    'total_profit_ref', coalesce((select round(sum(profit_ref), 2) from e), 0),
    'orders', coalesce((select count(distinct order_id) from e), 0),
    'daily', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(d order by d.day) from (
        select day, round(sum(profit_ref) filter (where area = 'TIENDA'), 2) tienda,
          round(sum(profit_ref) filter (where area = 'TALLER'), 2) taller
        from e group by day) d), '[]'::jsonb),
    'top_store', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
        select description, round(sum(quantity), 2) quantity, round(sum(revenue_ref), 2) revenue_ref,
          round(sum(profit_ref), 2) profit_ref, bool_or(cost_estimated) cost_estimated
        from e where area = 'TIENDA' and line_role = 'PRODUCT'
        group by description order by sum(profit_ref) desc limit 5) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'top_workshop', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
        select order_number, description, round(revenue_ref, 2) revenue_ref, round(profit_ref, 2) profit_ref
        from e where line_role = 'LABOR' order by profit_ref desc limit 5) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'missing_cost', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t) from (
        select description, round(sum(revenue_ref), 2) revenue_ref, count(*) lines
        from e where cost_estimated group by description order by sum(revenue_ref) desc limit 15) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', order_id, 'order_number', order_number, 'day', day, 'area', area, 'role', line_role,
        'description', description, 'revenue_ref', round(revenue_ref, 2), 'cost_ref', round(cost_ref, 2),
        'mechanics_ref', round(mechanics_ref, 2), 'cashea_ref', round(cashea_commission_ref, 2),
        'profit_ref', round(profit_ref, 2), 'estimated', cost_estimated) order by business_at desc)
      from e), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v;
  return v;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.order_oil_change_candidates(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_item_id uuid, kind text, description text, quantity numeric, unit_ref numeric, inventory_item_id uuid, product_id uuid, source text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  return query
  select i.id,
    case when coalesce(inv.category, p.category, '') ~* 'filtro' or i.description ~* 'filtro' then 'FILTER' else 'OIL' end,
    i.description, i.quantity,
    round(i.charged_ref_amount / nullif(i.quantity, 0), 4),
    i.inventory_item_id, coalesce(i.product_id, inv.product_id),
    case when i.inventory_item_id is not null then 'INVENTORY'
         when i.product_id is not null then 'CATALOG' else 'MANUAL' end
  from public.order_items i
  left join public.inventory_items inv on inv.id = i.inventory_item_id
  left join public.products p on p.id = i.product_id
  where i.order_id = p_order_id
    and i.item_type = 'PRODUCT'
    and lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i) = 'PRODUCT'
    and i.business_area <> 'OIL_CHANGE'
    and (
      coalesce(inv.category, p.category, '') ~* '^(aceite motor|aceite \d|aceite [0-9]+w|[0-9]+w[0-9]+$)'
      or coalesce(inv.category, p.category, '') ~* '^filtro (de )?aceite'
      or (i.inventory_item_id is null and i.product_id is null
          and i.description ~* '(\m[0-9]{1,2}w-?[0-9]{2}\M|filtro (de )?aceite)')
    )
  order by i.created_at, i.id;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payroll_advance_admin_history()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE response jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',a.id,'employee_id',a.employee_id,'employee_name',e.name,'paid_on',a.paid_on,
  'intended_period_end',a.intended_period_end,'account_code',fa.code,'currency',a.currency,
  'amount_original',a.amount_original,'usd_equivalent',a.usd_equivalent,'reference',a.reference,
  'note',a.note,'created_at',a.created_at,'movement_id',a.account_movement_id,
  'allocated_usd',coalesce(v.applied,0),
  'unapplied_usd',greatest(a.usd_equivalent-coalesce(v.applied,0),0),
  'applications',coalesce(v.details,'[]'::jsonb))
  ORDER BY a.paid_on DESC,a.created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO response
 FROM public.payroll_advances a
 JOIN public.employees e ON e.id=a.employee_id
 JOIN public.financial_accounts fa ON fa.id=a.account_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.usd_applied) applied,
   jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('run_id',x.payroll_run_id,'usd_applied',x.usd_applied,
    'period_end',r.period_end) ORDER BY x.created_at) details
  FROM public.payroll_advance_applications x
  JOIN public.payroll_runs r ON r.id=x.payroll_run_id WHERE x.advance_id=a.id) v ON true;
 RETURN response;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payroll_cashea_advance_integrity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cashea_payroll_policies p
   WHERE p.advance_adjustment_id=OLD.id) AND
   (OLD.amount_ref IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.amount_ref
     OR OLD.decision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.decision
     OR OLD.payroll_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.payroll_run_id)
 THEN
   -- Payroll settlement must be able to attach a run but cannot alter the bonus amount.
   IF OLD.amount_ref IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.amount_ref
      OR (OLD.decision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.decision AND pg_trigger_depth()=1)
   THEN
     -- Admin policy RPC is permitted through transaction-local setting.
     IF current_setting('lubricenter.cashea_policy_edit',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'yes'
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'La comisión adelantada solo puede modificarse desde Política Cashea'; END IF;
   END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payroll_cashea_options(p_end date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE response jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 IF p_end IS NULL OR extract(isodow from p_end)<>6
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selecciona el sábado de nómina'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'accrual_id',a.id,'employee_id',a.employee_id,'order_id',o.id,'order_number',o.order_number,
    'description',a.description,'full_commission_ref',a.amount_ref,'cashea_sale_id',s.id,
    'gross_ref',s.gross_ref,'cashea_service_fee_ref',s.commission_ref,'initial_ref',s.initial_ref,'financed_ref',s.financed_ref,
    'cashea_reference',s.cashea_reference,
    'commission_from_collections',coalesce(col.collected,0),
    'amount_to_advance',greatest(round(a.amount_ref-coalesce(col.collected,0),2),0),
    'mode',coalesce(pol.mode,'AS_COLLECTED'),
    'advance_adjustment_id',pol.advance_adjustment_id,
    'advance_already_liquidated',coalesce(ad.payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL,false),
    'installments',coalesce(inst.installments,'[]'::jsonb))
    ORDER BY o.order_number,a.description),'[]'::jsonb) INTO response
 FROM public.payroll_accruals a
 JOIN public.order_items i ON i.id=a.source_order_item_id
 JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=i.order_id AND o.status='CLOSED'
 JOIN public.cashea_sales s ON s.order_id=o.id
   AND s.status IN ('ACTIVE','SETTLED') AND s.ownership_status='OWN'
 LEFT JOIN public.cashea_payroll_policies pol ON pol.accrual_id=a.id
 LEFT JOIN public.payroll_adjustments ad ON ad.id=pol.advance_adjustment_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(w.obligation_usd) FILTER (WHERE w.reversal_of IS NULL
   AND w.decision='PAY') collected FROM public.payroll_work_items w
   WHERE w.accrual_id=a.id) col ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'installment_no',t.installment_no,'due_date',t.due_date,
    'amount_ref',t.amount_ref,'paid_ref',t.paid_ref,'status',t.status)
   ORDER BY t.installment_no) installments
    FROM public.cashea_installments t WHERE t.cashea_sale_id=s.id) inst ON true
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_work_items w
   WHERE w.accrual_id=a.id AND w.payroll_run_id IS NULL
   AND (w.earned_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date<=p_end)
 OR (pol.decision_week_end=p_end AND ad.payroll_run_id IS NULL);
 RETURN response;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payroll_employee_open_balance(p_employee_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE answer numeric;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(r.total_ref-coalesce(p.paid,0)-coalesce(adv.applied,0),0)),0)
 INTO answer FROM public.payroll_runs r
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT payroll_run_id,sum(usd_equivalent) paid FROM public.payroll_payments GROUP BY payroll_run_id) p
 ON p.payroll_run_id=r.id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT payroll_run_id,sum(usd_applied) applied FROM public.payroll_advance_applications GROUP BY payroll_run_id) adv
 ON adv.payroll_run_id=r.id
 WHERE r.employee_id=p_employee_id AND r.status='SETTLED' AND r.payroll_version>=3;
 RETURN answer;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payroll_transfer_draft(p_from_employee uuid, p_to_employee uuid, p_amount_usd numeric, p_reason text, p_occurred_on date)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid:=gen_random_uuid();v_from uuid;v_to uuid;
BEGIN
 PERFORM lubricenter_private.require_order_admin();
 IF p_from_employee IS NULL OR p_to_employee IS NULL OR p_from_employee=p_to_employee THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selecciona dos trabajadores diferentes'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.employees WHERE id=p_from_employee AND active)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.employees WHERE id=p_to_employee AND active) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ambos empleados deben estar activos'; END IF;
 IF p_amount_usd IS NULL OR p_amount_usd::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR p_amount_usd<=0 OR p_amount_usd>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Monto a reasignar inválido'; END IF;
 IF length(btrim(coalesce(p_reason,'')))<12 OR length(p_reason)>700 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Explica el incidente y la razón de la posible reasignación'; END IF;
 IF p_occurred_on IS NULL OR p_occurred_on>timezone('America/Caracas',now())::date
 OR p_occurred_on<timezone('America/Caracas',now())::date-90 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fecha de incidente inválida'; END IF;

 INSERT INTO public.payroll_adjustments(
 employee_id,adjustment_type,amount_ref,note,occurred_on,decision,
 transfer_id,transfer_role)
 VALUES(p_from_employee,'OTHER',-round(p_amount_usd,2),
  'Propuesta de compensación pendiente de autorización: '||btrim(p_reason),
  p_occurred_on,'HOLD',v_id,'FROM') RETURNING id INTO v_from;
 INSERT INTO public.payroll_adjustments(
 employee_id,adjustment_type,amount_ref,note,occurred_on,decision,
 transfer_id,transfer_role)
 VALUES(p_to_employee,'BONUS',round(p_amount_usd,2),
  'Compensación pendiente de aprobación: '||btrim(p_reason),
  p_occurred_on,'HOLD',v_id,'TO') RETURNING id INTO v_to;
 INSERT INTO public.audit_events(event_type,entity_type,entity_id,data)
 VALUES('payroll.transfer_draft_created','payroll_transfer',v_id,
  jsonb_build_object('from_employee',p_from_employee,'to_employee',p_to_employee,
   'amount_usd',round(p_amount_usd,2),'reason',btrim(p_reason),'actor',auth.uid(),
   'from_adjustment_id',v_from,'to_adjustment_id',v_to,
   'requires_legal_and_worker_consent',true));
 RETURN v_id;
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.profit_review_candidates()
 RETURNS TABLE(order_item_id uuid, order_id uuid, order_number text, business_at timestamp with time zone, description text, charged_ref numeric, role_now text, suggested_role text, reason text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  if not coalesce(public.can_administer_orders(), false) then raise exception 'Solo el dueño puede revisar'; end if;
  return query
  with lines as (
    select i.*, o.order_number, coalesce(o.business_at, o.closed_at) as bat,
      lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i) as role,
      exists(select 1 from public.order_items w where w.order_id = i.order_id
             and w.item_type = 'SERVICE' and w.business_area in ('WORKSHOP','ELECTROAUTO')) as has_workshop
    from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id = i.order_id
    where o.status = 'CLOSED' and i.line_role is null
  )
  select l.id, l.order_id, l.order_number, l.bat, l.description, round(l.charged_ref_amount, 2), l.role,
    case when l.role = 'LABOR' and l.description ~* 'cambio de aceite|aceite' then 'OIL_LABOR' else 'PASS_THROUGH' end,
    case when l.role = 'LABOR' and l.description ~* 'cambio de aceite|aceite'
        then 'Cambio de aceite registrado como trabajo de taller'
      else 'Producto escrito a mano en una orden de taller: ¿fue una compra para el trabajo?' end
  from lines l
  where (l.role = 'LABOR' and l.description ~* 'cambio de aceite')
     or (l.role = 'PRODUCT' and l.pricing_mode = 'MANUAL_NO_STOCK' and l.has_workshop)
  order by l.bat desc;
end $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_customer_master(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS TABLE(customer_id uuid, name text, phone text, document_id text, created_at timestamp with time zone, vehicle_count bigint, order_count bigint, total_ref numeric, last_visit_at timestamp with time zone, vehicles_text text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(trim(p_query), '');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1), 1000);
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  return query
  select c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.document_id, c.created_at,
    coalesce(vs.vehicle_count, 0), coalesce(os.order_count, 0), coalesce(os.total_ref, 0), os.last_visit_at, vs.vehicles_text
  from public.customers c
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) as vehicle_count,
      string_agg(trim(concat_ws(' ', v.plate, v.make, v.model, v.year::text)), ' · ' order by v.updated_at desc) as vehicles_text
    from public.vehicles v where v.customer_id = c.id
  ) vs on true
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) as order_count, sum(o.total_ref) as total_ref,
      max(coalesce(o.closed_at, o.opened_at)) as last_visit_at
    from public.orders o where o.customer_id = c.id
  ) os on true
  where v_query is null
     or concat_ws(' ', c.name, c.phone, c.document_id) ilike '%' || v_query || '%'
     or exists (select 1 from public.vehicles sv where sv.customer_id = c.id
       and concat_ws(' ', sv.plate, sv.make, sv.model, sv.year::text) ilike '%' || v_query || '%')
  order by os.last_visit_at desc nulls last, c.updated_at desc
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_order_admin(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_page integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with rows as (
  select o.id,o.order_number,o.status,o.customer_id,
   coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at) sale_at,o.created_at,
   o.corrects_order_id,o.cancellation_reason,c.name customer_name,v.plate,
   (cs.id is not null or r.id is not null) has_financed_sale,
   case when exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id and i.item_type='SERVICE')
     then 'Orden de servicio' else 'Venta' end kind,
   (select coalesce(sum(charged_ref_amount),0) from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id) total_ref,
   (select coalesce(sum(charged_ves_amount),0) from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id) total_ves,
   case when cs.id is not null then 'Cashea' when r.id is not null then 'Crédito LC'
     else 'Contado / mixto' end payment_type
  from public.orders o left join public.customers c on c.id=o.customer_id
  left join public.vehicles v on v.id=o.vehicle_id
  left join public.cashea_sales cs on cs.order_id=o.id
  left join public.receivables r on r.order_id=o.id
  where (p_status='ALL' or o.status=p_status)
   and (p_from is null or coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at)>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas'))
   and (p_to is null or coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at)<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas'))
   and (trim(p_query)='' or concat_ws(' ',o.order_number,c.name,c.phone,v.plate,v.make,v.model)
     ilike '%'||trim(p_query)||'%')
 ) select jsonb_build_object('count',(select count(*) from rows),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(r) from
     (select * from rows order by sale_at desc,id limit 30 offset greatest(p_page,0)*30) r),'[]'::jsonb))
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_order_collection_v2(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_page integer DEFAULT 0, p_payment_filter text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with base as (
 select
   o.id, o.order_number, o.status, o.customer_id,
   coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at) sale_at,
   o.cancellation_reason, c.name customer_name, v.plate,
   case when cs.id is not null then 'Cashea'
     when exists(select 1 from public.receivables rec
       where rec.order_id=o.id and rec.debtor_type='CUSTOMER') then 'Crédito LC'
     else 'Contado / mixto' end payment_type,
   (cs.id is not null or exists(select 1 from public.receivables rec where rec.order_id=o.id)) has_financed_sale,
   oi.kind, oi.total_ref, oi.total_ves, oi.services,
   coalesce(pay.paid_ves,0) collected_ves,
   coalesce(pay.paid_usd,0) collected_usd,
   coalesce(pay.paid_usd_ves,0) collected_usd_ves_equiv,
   coalesce(pay.payment_details,'[]'::jsonb) payment_details,
   case when cs.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
     'status',cs.status,
     'ownership_status',cs.ownership_status,
     'initial_percent',cs.initial_percent,
     'initial_bcv_usd',cs.initial_ref,
     'initial_ves',cs.initial_ves_snapshot,
     'financed_bcv_usd',cs.financed_ref,
     'total_bcv_usd',cs.gross_ref,
     'bcv_rate',cs.bcv_rate_snapshot,
     'reference',cs.cashea_reference,
     'initial_method',cs.initial_payment_method
   ) end cashea,
   cs.initial_ref cashea_initial_ref,
   cs.initial_ves_snapshot cashea_initial_ves,
   cs.financed_ref cashea_financed_ref
 from public.orders o
 left join public.customers c on c.id=o.customer_id
 left join public.vehicles v on v.id=o.vehicle_id
 left join lateral (
   select s.* from public.cashea_sales s
   where s.order_id=o.id order by s.created_at desc,s.id limit 1
 ) cs on true
 left join lateral (
   select
     case when count(*) filter(where i.item_type='SERVICE')>0
       then 'Orden de servicio' else 'Venta' end kind,
     coalesce(sum(i.charged_ref_amount),0) total_ref,
     coalesce(sum(i.charged_ves_amount),0) total_ves,
     string_agg(i.description,' · ' order by i.created_at) filter (where i.item_type='SERVICE') services
   from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id
 ) oi on true
 left join lateral (
   select
     coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='VES'),0) paid_ves,
     coalesce(sum(p.amount_original) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) paid_usd,
     coalesce(sum(p.value_ves) filter(where p.currency='USD'),0) paid_usd_ves,
     coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'method',p.method,
       'currency',p.currency,
       'amount_original',p.amount_original,
       'value_ves',p.value_ves,
       'bcv_rate',p.bcv_rate_snapshot,
       'equivalent_bcv',case when p.currency='VES'
         then p.amount_original/nullif(p.bcv_rate_snapshot,0)
         else p.value_ves/nullif(p.bcv_rate_snapshot,0) end,
       'reference_tail',right(coalesce(p.reference,''),4),
       'paid_at',p.paid_at
     ) order by p.paid_at,p.id) filter(where p.id is not null),'[]'::jsonb) payment_details
   from public.payments p where p.order_id=o.id
 ) pay on true
 where (p_status='ALL' or o.status=p_status)
   and (p_from is null or coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at)>=
     (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas'))
   and (p_to is null or coalesce(o.business_at,o.closed_at,o.opened_at)<
     ((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Caracas'))
   and (btrim(coalesce(p_query,''))='' or concat_ws(' ',
       o.order_number,c.name,c.phone,v.plate,v.make,v.model)
       ilike '%'||btrim(p_query)||'%')
), filtered as (
 select * from base b where
   p_payment_filter='ALL'
   or (p_payment_filter='CASHEA' and b.cashea is not null)
   or (p_payment_filter='CONTADO' and b.payment_type='Contado / mixto')
   or (p_payment_filter='CREDIT' and b.payment_type='Crédito LC')
), paged as (
 select id,order_number,status,customer_id,sale_at,cancellation_reason,customer_name,plate,
   payment_type,has_financed_sale,kind,services,total_ref,total_ves,
   collected_ves,collected_usd,collected_usd_ves_equiv,payment_details,cashea
 from filtered order by sale_at desc,id desc
 limit 30 offset greatest(coalesce(p_page,0),0)*30
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'count',(select count(*) from filtered),
 'summary',(
   select jsonb_build_object(
     'orders',count(*),
     'closed',count(*) filter(where status='CLOSED'),
     'cashea',count(*) filter(where status='CLOSED' and cashea is not null),
     'sales_ref',coalesce(sum(total_ref) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0),
     'collected_ves',coalesce(sum(collected_ves) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0),
     'collected_usd',coalesce(sum(collected_usd) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0),
     'cashea_initial_bcv',coalesce(sum(cashea_initial_ref) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0),
     'cashea_initial_ves',coalesce(sum(cashea_initial_ves) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0),
     'cashea_financed_bcv',coalesce(sum(cashea_financed_ref) filter(where status='CLOSED'),0)
   ) from filtered
 ),
 'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.sale_at desc,p.id desc) from paged p),'[]'::jsonb)
);
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_customer_followup_status(p_followup_id uuid, p_status text, p_snoozed_until date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.require_auth();
  if upper(coalesce(p_status,'')) not in ('PENDING','SENT','SNOOZED') then raise exception 'Estado inválido'; end if;
  update public.customer_followups
     set status=upper(p_status),
         sent_at=case when upper(p_status)='SENT' then now() else sent_at end,
         snoozed_until=case when upper(p_status)='SNOOZED' then p_snoozed_until else null end,
         updated_at=now()
   where id=p_followup_id;
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."product_catalog_current" WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
 SELECT p.id,
    p.name,
    p.category,
    p.filter_code,
    p.available,
    p.active,
    p.cash_usd_base_price,
    r.bcv_rate,
    r.operative_rate,
    round_to_step(p.cash_usd_base_price * r.operative_rate, COALESCE(( SELECT (app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[])::numeric AS "numeric"
           FROM app_settings
          WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_step'::text), 10::numeric), COALESCE(( SELECT app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[]
           FROM app_settings
          WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_mode'::text), 'nearest'::text)) AS current_price_ves,
        CASE
            WHEN r.bcv_rate > 0::numeric THEN round_to_step(p.cash_usd_base_price * r.operative_rate, COALESCE(( SELECT (app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[])::numeric AS "numeric"
               FROM app_settings
              WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_step'::text), 10::numeric), COALESCE(( SELECT app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[]
               FROM app_settings
              WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_mode'::text), 'nearest'::text)) / r.bcv_rate
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS current_ref_bcv
   FROM products p
     CROSS JOIN current_exchange_rates r
  WHERE p.active = true;

 SELECT ( SELECT exchange_rates.value

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."order_status_current" WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
 WITH item_totals AS (
         SELECT order_items.order_id,
            count(*)::integer AS item_count,
            COALESCE(sum(order_items.charged_ves_amount), 0::numeric) AS current_total_ves,
            COALESCE(sum(order_items.charged_ref_amount), 0::numeric) AS current_total_ref,
            string_agg(DISTINCT order_items.business_area, ', '::text ORDER BY order_items.business_area) AS service_areas
           FROM order_items
          GROUP BY order_items.order_id
        ), payment_totals AS (
         SELECT payments.order_id,
            COALESCE(sum(payments.value_ves), 0::numeric) AS paid_ves,
            COALESCE(sum(payments.value_ref), 0::numeric) AS paid_ref
           FROM payments
          GROUP BY payments.order_id
        ), open_credit AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (receivables.order_id) receivables.order_id,
            receivables.id AS receivable_id,
            receivables.status AS receivable_status,
            receivables.outstanding_ves,
            receivables.due_date
           FROM receivables
          ORDER BY receivables.order_id, receivables.created_at DESC
        ), crm AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_followups.order_id) customer_followups.order_id,
            customer_followups.status AS crm_status,
            customer_followups.sent_at,
            customer_followups.snoozed_until
           FROM customer_followups
          WHERE customer_followups.followup_type = 'POST_SERVICE'::text
          ORDER BY customer_followups.order_id, customer_followups.created_at DESC
        ), cashea AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (cashea_sales.order_id) cashea_sales.order_id,
            cashea_sales.id AS cashea_sale_id,
            cashea_sales.status AS cashea_status
           FROM cashea_sales
          ORDER BY cashea_sales.order_id, cashea_sales.created_at DESC
        )
 SELECT o.id,
    o.order_number,
    o.status,
    o.customer_id,
    o.vehicle_id,
    o.opened_at,
    o.closed_at,
    o.workflow_status,
    o.workflow_updated_at,
    o.health_status,
    o.health_reviewed_at,
    COALESCE(i.item_count, 0) AS item_count,
    COALESCE(i.current_total_ves,
        CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED'::text THEN o.total_ves
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS current_total_ves,
    COALESCE(i.current_total_ref,
        CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED'::text THEN o.total_ref
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END) AS current_total_ref,
    COALESCE(p.paid_ves, 0::numeric) AS paid_ves,
    COALESCE(p.paid_ref, 0::numeric) AS paid_ref,
    i.service_areas,
    c.receivable_id,
    c.receivable_status,
    c.outstanding_ves,
    c.due_date,
    crm.crm_status,
    crm.sent_at AS crm_sent_at,
    crm.snoozed_until AS crm_snoozed_until,
        CASE
            WHEN cs.cashea_sale_id IS NOT NULL AND (cs.cashea_status = ANY (ARRAY['ACTIVE'::text, 'SETTLED'::text])) THEN 'CASHEA'::text
            WHEN c.receivable_status = 'OPEN'::text THEN 'CREDIT_LC'::text
            WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED'::text THEN 'PAID'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(i.current_total_ves, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN 'NOT_STARTED'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(p.paid_ves, 0::numeric) <= 1::numeric THEN 'UNPAID'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(p.paid_ves, 0::numeric) + 1::numeric) < COALESCE(i.current_total_ves, 0::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
            ELSE 'PAID_PENDING_CLOSE'::text
        END AS financial_status,
        CASE
            WHEN o.status <> 'CLOSED'::text THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
            WHEN crm.crm_status IS NULL THEN 'NO_FOLLOWUP'::text
            ELSE crm.crm_status
        END AS crm_state
   FROM orders o
     LEFT JOIN item_totals i ON i.order_id = o.id
     LEFT JOIN payment_totals p ON p.order_id = o.id
     LEFT JOIN open_credit c ON c.order_id = o.id
     LEFT JOIN crm ON crm.order_id = o.id
     LEFT JOIN cashea cs ON cs.order_id = o.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts" WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
 WITH all_oil AS (
         SELECT s.id,
            s.vehicle_id,
            s.customer_id,
            s.performed_at,
            s.created_at,
            (s.performed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas'::text)::date AS service_day,
            s.odometer,
            s.next_service_date,
            s.next_service_odometer,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.vehicle_id ORDER BY s.performed_at DESC, s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM service_records s
             JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = s.vehicle_id
          WHERE s.service_type = 'OIL_CHANGE'::text AND s.customer_id = v.customer_id AND v.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM orders o
                  WHERE o.id = s.order_id AND o.status = 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), recent AS (
         SELECT all_oil.id,
            all_oil.vehicle_id,
            all_oil.customer_id,
            all_oil.performed_at,
            all_oil.created_at,
            all_oil.service_day,
            all_oil.odometer,
            all_oil.next_service_date,
            all_oil.next_service_odometer,
            all_oil.rn
           FROM all_oil
          WHERE all_oil.rn <= 12
        ), dedup AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (recent.vehicle_id, recent.service_day) recent.vehicle_id,
            recent.service_day,
            recent.odometer,
            recent.id,
            recent.performed_at
           FROM recent
          ORDER BY recent.vehicle_id, recent.service_day, recent.performed_at DESC, recent.id DESC
        ), points AS (
         SELECT dedup.vehicle_id,
            dedup.service_day,
            dedup.odometer,
            dedup.id,
            dedup.performed_at
           FROM dedup
          WHERE dedup.odometer >= 100 AND dedup.odometer <= 900000
        ), slopes AS (
         SELECT a.vehicle_id,
            ((b.odometer - a.odometer)::numeric / (b.service_day - a.service_day)::numeric)::double precision AS rate
           FROM points a
             JOIN points b ON a.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND b.service_day > a.service_day
          WHERE (b.service_day - a.service_day) >= 14 AND (b.service_day - a.service_day) <= 730 AND b.odometer > a.odometer AND ((b.odometer - a.odometer)::numeric / (b.service_day - a.service_day)::numeric) >= 1::numeric AND ((b.odometer - a.odometer)::numeric / (b.service_day - a.service_day)::numeric) <= 350::numeric
        ), median_slopes AS (
         SELECT slopes.vehicle_id,
            count(*)::integer AS pair_count,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY slopes.rate) AS median_rate
           FROM slopes
          GROUP BY slopes.vehicle_id
        ), slope_mad AS (
         SELECT s.vehicle_id,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (abs(s.rate - m.median_rate))) AS mad
           FROM slopes s
             JOIN median_slopes m USING (vehicle_id)
          GROUP BY s.vehicle_id
        ), sequenced AS (
         SELECT d.vehicle_id,
            d.service_day,
            d.odometer,
            d.id,
            d.performed_at,
            lag(d.service_day) OVER (PARTITION BY d.vehicle_id ORDER BY d.service_day) AS previous_day,
            lag(d.odometer) OVER (PARTITION BY d.vehicle_id ORDER BY d.service_day) AS previous_km
           FROM dedup d
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT sequenced.vehicle_id,
            count(*)::integer AS services,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced.odometer >= 100 AND sequenced.odometer <= 900000)::integer AS mileage_points,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sequenced.previous_km >= 100 AND sequenced.previous_km <= 900000 AND sequenced.odometer >= 100 AND sequenced.odometer <= 900000 AND sequenced.odometer < sequenced.previous_km)::integer AS regressions
           FROM sequenced
          GROUP BY sequenced.vehicle_id
        ), intervals AS (
         SELECT sequenced.vehicle_id,
            (sequenced.service_day - sequenced.previous_day)::double precision AS days
           FROM sequenced
          WHERE sequenced.previous_day IS NOT NULL AND (sequenced.service_day - sequenced.previous_day) >= 14 AND (sequenced.service_day - sequenced.previous_day) <= 540
        ), median_visits AS (
         SELECT intervals.vehicle_id,
            count(*)::integer AS valid_intervals,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY intervals.days) AS median_days
           FROM intervals
          GROUP BY intervals.vehicle_id
        ), visit_mad AS (
         SELECT i.vehicle_id,
            percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (abs(i.days - m.median_days))) AS mad
           FROM intervals i
             JOIN median_visits m USING (vehicle_id)
          GROUP BY i.vehicle_id
        ), features AS (
         SELECT a.id AS service_record_id,
            a.vehicle_id,
            a.customer_id,
            a.service_day,
            a.odometer AS last_odometer,
            COALESCE(a.next_service_date, a.service_day + 90) AS calendar_due_date,
            COALESCE(c.services, 0) AS visits,
            COALESCE(c.mileage_points, 0) AS mileage_points,
            COALESCE(c.regressions, 0) AS regressions,
            COALESCE(s.pair_count, 0) AS pairs,
            s.median_rate,
            sm.mad AS slope_mad,
            COALESCE(v.valid_intervals, 0) AS valid_intervals,
            v.median_days,
            vm.mad AS visit_mad,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.odometer >= 100 AND a.odometer <= 900000 THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN a.next_service_odometer >= (a.odometer + 1000) AND a.next_service_odometer <= (a.odometer + 15000) THEN LEAST(a.odometer + 5000, a.next_service_odometer)
                        ELSE a.odometer + 5000
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS due_km
           FROM all_oil a
             LEFT JOIN counts c USING (vehicle_id)
             LEFT JOIN median_slopes s USING (vehicle_id)
             LEFT JOIN slope_mad sm USING (vehicle_id)
             LEFT JOIN median_visits v USING (vehicle_id)
             LEFT JOIN visit_mad vm USING (vehicle_id)
          WHERE a.rn = 1
        ), quality AS (
         SELECT f.service_record_id,
            f.vehicle_id,
            f.customer_id,
            f.service_day,
            f.last_odometer,
            f.calendar_due_date,
            f.visits,
            f.mileage_points,
            f.regressions,
            f.pairs,
            f.median_rate,
            f.slope_mad,
            f.valid_intervals,
            f.median_days,
            f.visit_mad,
            f.due_km,
                CASE
                    WHEN f.mileage_points < 2 OR f.pairs < 1 OR f.regressions > 0 OR f.last_odometer < 100 OR f.last_odometer > 900000 OR f.median_rate IS NULL OR f.slope_mad > (f.median_rate * 0.6::double precision) THEN 'INSUFFICIENT'::text
                    WHEN f.mileage_points >= 4 AND f.pairs >= 6 AND f.slope_mad <= (f.median_rate * 0.20::double precision) AND (CURRENT_DATE - f.service_day) <= 240 THEN 'HIGH'::text
                    WHEN f.mileage_points >= 3 AND f.pairs >= 3 AND f.slope_mad <= (f.median_rate * 0.40::double precision) AND (CURRENT_DATE - f.service_day) <= 360 THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
                    ELSE 'LOW'::text
                END AS confidence,
                CASE
                    WHEN f.visits >= 3 AND f.valid_intervals >= 2 AND f.median_days >= 28::double precision AND f.median_days <= 365::double precision AND f.visit_mad <= (f.median_days * 0.35::double precision) THEN round(f.median_days)::integer
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS habitual_days
           FROM features f
        ), predictions AS (
         SELECT q.service_record_id,
            q.vehicle_id,
            q.customer_id,
            q.service_day,
            q.last_odometer,
            q.calendar_due_date,
            q.visits,
            q.mileage_points,
            q.regressions,
            q.pairs,
            q.median_rate,
            q.slope_mad,
            q.valid_intervals,
            q.median_days,
            q.visit_mad,
            q.due_km,
            q.confidence,
            q.habitual_days,
                CASE
                    WHEN q.confidence <> 'INSUFFICIENT'::text AND q.due_km IS NOT NULL AND ceil((q.due_km - q.last_odometer)::double precision / q.median_rate) >= 14::double precision AND ceil((q.due_km - q.last_odometer)::double precision / q.median_rate) <= 540::double precision THEN q.service_day + ceil((q.due_km - q.last_odometer)::double precision / q.median_rate)::integer
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS km_due_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN q.habitual_days IS NOT NULL THEN q.service_day + q.habitual_days
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS habitual_due_date
           FROM quality q
        )
 SELECT service_record_id,
    vehicle_id,
    customer_id,
    service_day AS last_service_date,
    last_odometer,
    due_km,
    calendar_due_date,
    visits AS service_count,
    mileage_points,
    pairs AS slope_pairs,
    regressions AS odometer_regressions,
        CASE
            WHEN confidence <> 'INSUFFICIENT'::text THEN round(median_rate::numeric, 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS km_per_day,
        CASE
            WHEN confidence <> 'INSUFFICIENT'::text THEN round((5000::double precision / median_rate)::numeric)::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS days_per_5000km,
        CASE
            WHEN median_days IS NOT NULL THEN round(median_days::numeric)::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS typical_visit_days,
    km_due_date AS projected_km_due_date,
    habitual_due_date AS projected_habit_due_date,
    LEAST(calendar_due_date, km_due_date, habitual_due_date) AS recommended_due_date,
    confidence,
        CASE
            WHEN km_due_date IS NOT NULL AND km_due_date <= calendar_due_date AND (habitual_due_date IS NULL OR km_due_date <= habitual_due_date) THEN 'KM_USAGE'::text
            WHEN habitual_due_date IS NOT NULL AND habitual_due_date <= calendar_due_date THEN 'VISIT_PATTERN'::text
            ELSE 'CALENDAR_LIMIT'::text
        END AS due_reason
   FROM predictions p;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."maintenance_reminders_current" WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
 WITH forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.service_record_id,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.vehicle_id,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.customer_id,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.last_service_date,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.last_odometer,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.due_km,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.calendar_due_date,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.service_count,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.mileage_points,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.slope_pairs,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.odometer_regressions,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.km_per_day,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.days_per_5000km,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.typical_visit_days,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.projected_km_due_date,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.projected_habit_due_date,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.recommended_due_date,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.confidence,
            vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts.due_reason
           FROM vehicle_oil_usage_forecasts
        ), cutoff AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT TRIM(BOTH '"'::text FROM app_settings.value::text)::date AS btrim
                   FROM app_settings
                  WHERE app_settings.key = 'crm_operational_start_date'::text), '2026-09-10'::date) AS start_date
        )
 SELECT f.service_record_id,
    f.vehicle_id,
    v.customer_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    c.phone AS customer_phone,
    v.plate,
    v.make,
    v.model,
    v.year,
    v.current_odometer,
    s.performed_at,
    s.odometer AS service_odometer,
    s.oil_brand,
    s.oil_viscosity,
    s.oil_filter_code,
    COALESCE(f.due_km, s.next_service_odometer) AS next_service_odometer,
    f.recommended_due_date AS next_service_date,
        CASE
            WHEN a.status IS NOT NULL THEN a.status
            WHEN f.recommended_due_date < cutoff.start_date THEN 'SENT'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS reminder_status,
    a.snoozed_until,
        CASE
            WHEN a.sent_at IS NOT NULL THEN a.sent_at
            WHEN a.status IS NULL AND f.recommended_due_date < cutoff.start_date THEN f.recommended_due_date::timestamp with time zone
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS sent_at,
        CASE
            WHEN a.status = 'SENT'::text THEN 'SENT'::text
            WHEN a.status IS NULL AND f.recommended_due_date < cutoff.start_date THEN 'SENT'::text
            WHEN a.status = 'SNOOZED'::text AND a.snoozed_until > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas'::text)::date THEN 'SNOOZED'::text
            WHEN f.recommended_due_date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas'::text)::date THEN 'DUE'::text
            WHEN f.due_km IS NOT NULL AND v.current_odometer >= f.due_km THEN 'DUE'::text
            WHEN f.recommended_due_date <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas'::text)::date + 14) THEN 'SOON'::text
            ELSE 'UPCOMING'::text
        END AS urgency,
    f.service_count,
    f.mileage_points,
    f.slope_pairs,
    f.km_per_day,
    f.days_per_5000km,
    f.typical_visit_days,
    f.projected_km_due_date,
    f.projected_habit_due_date,
    f.calendar_due_date,
    f.confidence AS forecast_confidence,
    f.due_reason
   FROM forecast f
     JOIN service_records s ON s.id = f.service_record_id
     JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = f.vehicle_id AND v.customer_id = f.customer_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.id = v.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN maintenance_reminder_actions a ON a.service_record_id = f.service_record_id
     CROSS JOIN cutoff;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."inventory_current" WITH (security_invoker=true) AS
 WITH stock AS (
         SELECT inventory_movements.inventory_item_id,
            inventory_movements.location_id,
            sum(inventory_movements.quantity_delta) AS quantity_on_hand
           FROM inventory_movements
          GROUP BY inventory_movements.inventory_item_id, inventory_movements.location_id
        ), rounding AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT (app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[])::numeric AS "numeric"
                   FROM app_settings
                  WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_step'::text), 10::numeric) AS step,
            COALESCE(( SELECT app_settings.value #>> '{}'::text[]
                   FROM app_settings
                  WHERE app_settings.key = 'price_rounding_mode'::text), 'nearest'::text) AS mode
        ), priced AS (
         SELECT i_1.id,
                CASE
                    WHEN i_1.price_usd > 0::numeric AND r.operative_rate > 0::numeric THEN round_to_step(i_1.price_usd * r.operative_rate, rounding.step, rounding.mode)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS price_ves,
            r.bcv_rate
           FROM inventory_items i_1
             CROSS JOIN current_exchange_rates r
             CROSS JOIN rounding
        )
 SELECT i.id,
    i.sku,
    i.brand,
    i.description,
    i.category,
    i.unit,
    i.source_cost_ref,
    i.source_stock_imported,
    i.source_alert,
    i.source_price_status,
    i.needs_review,
    i.cost_missing,
    i.product_id,
    l.id AS location_id,
    l.code AS location_code,
    l.name AS location_name,
    COALESCE(s.quantity_on_hand, 0::numeric) AS quantity_on_hand,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(s.quantity_on_hand, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS sellable_quantity,
    i.display_name AS catalog_product_name,
    i.price_usd AS cash_usd_base_price,
    pr.price_ves AS current_price_ves,
        CASE
            WHEN pr.bcv_rate > 0::numeric THEN pr.price_ves / pr.bcv_rate
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS current_ref_bcv,
    i.imported_at,
    i.updated_at,
    i.alt_codes,
    i.display_name,
    i.price_usd,
    i.price_updated_at,
    i.image_url
   FROM inventory_items i
     CROSS JOIN locations l
     LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.inventory_item_id = i.id AND s.location_id = l.id
     LEFT JOIN priced pr ON pr.id = i.id
  WHERE i.active = true AND l.active = true;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."order_line_economics" AS
 WITH cashea AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT cs.order_id
           FROM cashea_sales cs
          WHERE cs.status <> 'CANCELLED'::text
        ), cfg AS (
         SELECT lubricenter_private.setting_number('store_markup_percent'::text, 35::numeric) AS markup,
            lubricenter_private.setting_number('cashea_commission_percent'::text, 4::numeric) AS commission
        )
 SELECT i.id AS order_item_id,
    i.order_id,
    o.order_number,
    COALESCE(o.business_at, o.closed_at, o.opened_at) AS business_at,
    lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i.*) AS line_role,
        CASE
            WHEN lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i.*) = ANY (ARRAY['LABOR'::text, 'CASHEA_SURCHARGE'::text]) THEN 'TALLER'::text
            ELSE 'TIENDA'::text
        END AS area,
    i.business_area,
    i.description,
    i.quantity,
    c.order_id IS NOT NULL AS paid_with_cashea,
    round(i.charged_ref_amount, 4) AS revenue_ref,
    round(
        CASE lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i.*)
            WHEN 'PRODUCT'::text THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(i.total_cost_ref_snapshot, 0::numeric), COALESCE(i.list_ref_amount, i.base_ref_amount, i.charged_ref_amount) / (1::numeric + cfg.markup / 100::numeric))
            WHEN 'PASS_THROUGH'::text THEN COALESCE(i.pass_through_cost_ref, i.charged_ref_amount)
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END, 4) AS cost_ref,
    lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i.*) = 'PRODUCT'::text AND COALESCE(i.total_cost_ref_snapshot, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric AS cost_estimated,
    round(COALESCE(i.worker_share_ref_snapshot, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(i.assistant_bonus_ref_snapshot, 0::numeric), 4) AS mechanics_ref,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN c.order_id IS NOT NULL AND (lubricenter_private.effective_line_role(i.*) = ANY (ARRAY['LABOR'::text, 'CASHEA_SURCHARGE'::text])) THEN i.charged_ref_amount * cfg.commission / 100::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END, 4) AS cashea_commission_ref
   FROM order_items i
     JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'CLOSED'::text
     LEFT JOIN cashea c ON c.order_id = i.order_id
     CROSS JOIN cfg;
